e35c94a6.title: Data Analytics Customer Engineer, Google Cloud (English)
e35c94a6.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience as a data or systems engineer, solutions architect, or pre-sales consultant.
* Experience delivering demos, workshops, or architect overviews to business leaders.
* Experience migrating, refactoring, or debugging proprietary or open source workloads.
* Experience building data platforms, warehouses, or data lakes, and experience with data programming languages and leveraging agentic platforms.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to manage stakeholder relationships.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience designing and deploying enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM) application integrations, or context orchestration frameworks.
* Experience implementing enterprise data/AI governance, metadata management, access control, or lineage tracking across modern catalogs.
* Experience with developer advocacy, building internal technical programs, delivering technical enablement, or contributing to open-source data/AI communities.
* Experience in core data science workflows, including proficiency with data manipulation libraries and integrating data pipelines with ML platforms.
* Experience applying value-selling principles to align technical architectures with business outcomes.

**About The Job**
As an Agentic Data Cloud Customer Engineer, you are the premier technical subject matter expert in your territory. You will partner with Sales Specialists to execute the technical pre-sales strategy for customers, serving as the trusted technical advisor to CDOs, CTOs, Lead Architects, and developers. You will lead proactive discoveries to map complex, legacy customer data estates and qualify them for migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
You are a builder and architect that designs, codes, and deploys production-grade, end-to-end Data + AI pipelines that solve real-world enterprise problems. You will whiteboard modern open lakehouse architectures and run code demonstrations showing how unified data foundations power deterministic, hallucination-free conversational AI.
  
  
Leveraging a background in value-selling, you will conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership analyses and optimize architectures to prevent runaway spend. You will help customers adopt modern data engineering practices that securely unify data, analytics, and AI. If you possess deep expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data systems, and can translate technical excellence into business-transforming migrations, you will grow in this highly technical role.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy for large accounts, engaging C-level executives via live demonstrations to solve business problems using the Agentic Data Cloud.
* Design, code, and deploy production-grade Data + AI pipelines (e.g., fraud detection, recommendation engines) and map legacy data estates to open-format architectures (Apache Iceberg).
* Orchestrate Intent-Driven data engineering to autonomously deploy PySpark pipelines using the Data Agent Kit, Antigravity, and Model Context Protocol.
* Lead high-impact showcases and technical value validations using BigQuery, Borderless Lakehouse, Knowledge Catalog, Spark, and Vertex AI to prove business outcomes.
* Conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses and optimize architectures (such as balancing DRAM/SSD, compute shapes, and token spend) to prevent runaway costs on the Lightning Engine.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We are looking for an experienced **ServiceNow SOMT Solution Architect** with strong expertise in Telecom Service Management, telecom order management, and end-to-end service fulfillment architecture. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing scalable ServiceNow solutions for telecom and fiber services, including Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Fulfillment, provisioning, billing, and MACD (Move, Add, Change, Disconnect) lifecycle processes.

The candidate should also have practical experience with ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), enterprise integrations, and solution architecture, with the ability to align standard ServiceNow capabilities with complex telecom business requirements while minimizing unnecessary customization.

* Establish reusable architectural standards, design principles, and integration patterns.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Solutioning**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, product owners, and enterprise architects to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Lead architecture discussions, requirement workshops, solution reviews, and technical presentations.
* Provide solutioning and presales support, including effort estimation, solution proposals, and architectural recommendations.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support development teams during implementation and ensure solutions remain aligned with the approved architecture.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum **9+ years of overall IT experience**, preferably in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or technical architecture roles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

560ad10a.title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
560ad10a.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)
* Experience designing generative AI, machine learning and data analytics solutions
* Experience with large-scale migration programs (1,000+ servers) using AWS migration tools and methods
* Software development experience in an object-oriented language

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra

366f3007.title: Application Architect
366f3007.description:
The organization is seeking an accomplished Application Architect to assume technical leadership for the design, governance, and continuous evolution of enterprise-grade applications. The successful candidate shall be a hands-on full stack architect possessing deep proficiency in software engineering fundamentals, enterprise application integration, high-throughput OLTP database design, and contemporary JavaScript-based frontend architectures. The incumbent will be entrusted with the formulation of architectural blueprints, the establishment of engineering standards, and the technical mentorship of development teams in the delivery of scalable, resilient, and maintainable enterprise solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the end-to-end architecture of enterprise applications spanning presentation, business, integration, and data tiers.
* Accountable for ensuring application designs and implementations remain structurally sound under scale, failure, and change, and for identifying, calling out, and correcting architectural deviations early.
* Establish, document, and enforce architectural standards, engineering guidelines, and best practices across all development teams.
* Make and document architectural trade-offs across performance, simplicity, operability, and long-term evolution, with clear articulation of rationale and consequences.
* Lead the appropriate application of design patterns and enterprise integration patterns in the resolution of complex business problems.
* Architect scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-performance distributed systems aligned with organizational objectives.
* Ensure application behaviour remains predictable at runtime by evaluating concurrency models, integration choices, failure scenarios, and recovery pathsnot just static designs or diagrams.
* Drive technology evaluations, proof-of-concept initiatives, and the formal documentation of Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Collaborate extensively with product management, business stakeholders, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive solution delivery.
* Provide technical mentorship to engineering staff through architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, and structured code reviews.
* Conduct ongoing performance analysis and optimization of applications, database systems, and overall system throughput.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and continually refine the organization's architectural roadmap accordingly.

  

**Required Technical Competencies**

**Design Patterns and Software Architecture**

* Demonstrated and comprehensive mastery of the Gang of Four (GoF) design patterns, encompassing Creational, Structural, and Behavioral categories.
* Proven ability to apply patterns judiciously, including but not limited to Factory, Strategy, Observer, Decorator, Adapter, Proxy, Command, and Chain of Responsibility, in the context of real-world enterprise problems.
* Thorough understanding of SOLID principles, along with DRY, KISS, YAGNI, and clean architecture methodologies.
* Substantive experience with architectural styles including layered, hexagonal, microservices, event-driven, and CQRS architectures.

**System Design**

* Demonstrated expertise in the design of large-scale, distributed, and highly available systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of scalability principles, load balancing strategies, caching mechanisms, sharding, replication, and the CAP theorem.
* Substantive experience with API design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and asynchronous communication paradigms, including message queues and event streaming platforms.
* Demonstrated capability in capacity planning, architectural trade-off analysis, and the engineering of non-functional requirements pertaining to performance, security, and availability.

**Application Integration and Enterprise Integration Patterns**

* Practical experience with messaging patterns including Message Channel, Message Router, Content-Based Router, Aggregator, Splitter, Scatter-Gather, and Saga.
* Demonstrated familiarity with enterprise integration platforms and middleware solutions such as Apache Camel, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, and ActiveMQ.
* Experience with B2B and legacy integration standards including SOAP/WSDL, XML/XSLT transformations.
* Sound understanding of reliability semantics in integration design, including idempotency, retry strategies with exponential backoff, circuit breakers, dead-letter queues, poison-message handling, and at-least-once versus exactly-once delivery guarantees.
* Proficiency in data transformation, canonical data model design, schema registry usage (Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema), and contract-first integration approaches.
* Proven track record in the design of reliable, loosely coupled integrations across heterogeneous enterprise systems.

**Operating Systems, Data Structures, and Algorithms**

* Robust foundational knowledge of operating system concepts, including processes and threads, scheduling, memory management, file systems, inter-process communication, and virtualization.
* Comprehensive command of data structures (arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hash tables, heaps) and core algorithms (sorting,searching, dynamic programming, and graph traversal).
* Demonstrated ability to perform asymptotic analysis (Big-O notation) and to select optimal solutions in accordance with given constraints.
* Working knowledge of concurrency primitives, including locks, semaphores, monitors, atomic operations, and memory models.

**Structured Concurrency and Reactive Programming**

* Substantive experience with structured concurrency models, including Java Project Loom virtual threads, Kotlin coroutines, and structured task scopes.
* Comprehensive understanding of reactive programming principles, encompassing backpressure handling, non-blocking input/output, and event-driven stream processing.
* Practical experience with reactive frameworks such as Project Reactor, RxJava, RxJS, or Spring WebFlux.
* Demonstrated capability in the design of responsive, resilient, elastic, and message-driven systems in accordance with the principles set forth in the Reactive Manifesto.

**Full-Stack Development and Architecture**

* Comprehensive command of JavaScript fundamentals, including closures, prototypes, the event loop, asynchronous programming (async/await and Promises), modules, and ES6 and subsequent language features.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type system features, generics, and the application of strict typing within large enterprise codebases.
* Substantive hands-on experience delivering production-grade applications using either ReactJS (including hooks, context, and state management libraries) or AngularJS; expertise in both shall be considered an advantage.
* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, responsive design methodologies, and contemporary frontend tooling such as Webpack, Vite, esbuild, and modern package managers.
* Familiarity with frontend build and deployment architecture, including bundling strategy, CDN distribution, and cache invalidation mechanisms.
* Demonstrated backend competency in at least one major enterprise ecosystem, including Java/Spring, Node.js, .NET, or Python.
* Solid understanding of containerization technologies (Docker), orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), and continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
* Strong foundational understanding of relational database architecture, including schema design, indexing strategy, transaction boundaries, and isolation levels.
* Demonstrated ability to design application data models and access patterns that remain correct under concurrency, retries, partial failures, and autoscaling.
* Clear understanding of OLTP system characteristics and the architectural distinction between transactional and analytical workloads.
* Working expertise with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and PL/SQL sufficient to evaluate schema design, query patterns, and transactional safety.
* Ability to assess and govern concurrency control mechanisms, including optimistic versus pessimistic locking and MVCC, from an application behavior perspective.
* Experience designing applications that use connection pools, transactions, and retries safely and predictably.
* Understanding of highavailability data patterns (replication, failover, read/write separation) insofar as they impact application correctness and behavior.
* Familiarity with NoSQL and cachebased stores applied selectively as part of a broader persistence strategy, not as default replacements.

2b362d76.title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect LAN
2b362d76.description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's local area network and campus switching platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

**Business Stakeholders**

* Business stakeholders sponsoring platform capability with architectural consequence
* Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

**Tech Stakeholders**

* Platform Architecture Director as owner of domain target architecture
* Platform engineering teams applying the patterns and standards
* Product Owner and Platform Manager for roadmap and backlog consequence
* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects for enterprise alignment
* Information Security and Reliability Engineering for security and resilience standards

**Other**

* Managed service partners whose solution designs must meet platform architecture standards
* Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise local area network and campus switching services.
* Deep knowledge of routing, switching, quality of service, resilience, segmentation and network access control.
* Evidence of defining campus architectures that improved standardisation, security, availability or lifecycle efficiency.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Expert level enterprise switching certification, such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or JNCIE Enterprise Routing and Switching.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, Juniper EX or Juniper Mist platforms.
* Experience with software defined campus, automation or operational technology networks.

**Related Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

Automation Technology, Cisco IP, Cisco Switching, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Design Assurance, IP Address Management (IPAM), Juniper MX, LAN Architecture, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Resilience Planning, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

90912bcd.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
90912bcd.description:
About the Role

ConceptNXT Technologies is expanding its technology services portfolio by establishing dedicated capabilities in Cloud Consulting, Cloud Infrastructure, Migration, DevOps and Managed Services.We are looking for a hands-on Cloud & DevOps Engineer who can design implementation-level solutions, deploy and manage cloud infrastructure, execute customer migration projects and develop automation capabilities across cloud environments.The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience with Microsoft Azure, working knowledge of AWS and proven ability to implement secure, reliable and cost-effective cloud solutions.This is a customer-facing engineering role requiring technical ownership, troubleshooting ability, implementation discipline and a willingness to contribute to a growing cloud services practice. The engineer will work closely with the Cloud Architect and existing Technology & Solutions team to deliver customer projects and establish reusable technical standards.

**Experience Required:** Minimum 4+ Years

Key Responsibilities  
***A. Cloud Infrastructure Implementation***

* Deploy, configure and manage Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services.
* Implement virtual machines, storage, networking, identity, backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Configure virtual networks, subnets, routing, VPN connectivity, network security groups and load-balancing components.
* Implement hybrid connectivity between customer on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Execute infrastructure sizing, configuration, performance tuning and operational optimisation.
* Implement approved cloud architectures in collaboration with the Cloud Architect.
* Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure and connectivity issues.

* Perform migration testing, validation, cutover and post-migration support.
* Identify technical dependencies, migration risks and operational requirements.
* Prepare migration runbooks, implementation documentation and handover materials.

***C. DevOps & Infrastructure Automation***

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and relevant cloud-native tools.
* Implement deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
* Develop PowerShell, Bash or Python scripts for infrastructure provisioning and operational automation.
* Apply version control, configuration management and repeatable deployment practices.
* Support containerised workloads using Docker and relevant container orchestration technologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual deployment effort and improve implementation consistency.

***D. Cloud Security & Governance***

* Implement cloud identity and access controls, including RBAC, MFA and least-privilege access.
* Configure security policies, logging, monitoring and resource protection controls.
* Apply approved cloud security baselines and infrastructure hardening practices.
* Implement backup, recovery and disaster recovery configurations.
* Support cloud governance, resource tagging, policy enforcement and configuration compliance.
* Work with cybersecurity specialists when projects require advanced security expertise.

***E. Cloud Monitoring, Operations & Optimisation***

* Configure cloud monitoring, logging and alerting.
* Troubleshoot performance, availability, infrastructure and connectivity issues.
* Analyse cloud resource utilisation and recommend optimisation opportunities.
* Support cloud cost management and identify unnecessary or inefficient resource consumption.
* Develop operational runbooks, maintenance procedures and monitoring standards.
* Support the transition of completed cloud projects into ongoing support or managed services.

***F. Customer Project Delivery***

* Participate in customer technical discussions, implementation workshops and project planning.
* Translate approved solution designs into implementation activities and technical deliverables.
* Execute assigned cloud implementation and migration projects within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with customer IT teams, OEMs and technology partners.
* Perform technical testing, issue resolution and implementation validation.
* Prepare configuration documents, implementation reports, SOPs and customer handover documents.
* Conduct customer knowledge-transfer and technical enablement sessions.

***G. Internal Capability Development***

* Help establish standard deployment templates, scripts, checklists and reusable cloud configurations.
* Support the development of ConceptNXT’s cloud engineering practices and delivery standards.
* Assist presales teams with technical feasibility assessments, demonstrations and implementation estimates.
* Maintain relevant technical certifications and stay current with cloud platform developments.
* Share technical knowledge with existing infrastructure and support teams.

***Additional Technical Skills***

Microsoft Azure - Strong Hands-on Experience

* Azure Virtual Machines, Storage and Networking
* Azure Virtual Networks, VPN, NSG and related connectivity services
* Azure Backup and disaster recovery capabilities
* Azure Monitor, logging and alerting
* Microsoft Entra ID and Azure RBAC
* Azure resource governance and cost optimisation

Infrastructure & Systems

* Windows Server and Linux administration
* TCP/IP networking, DNS, routing, VPN and firewalls
* Virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
* Backup, recovery and infrastructure troubleshooting
* Hybrid infrastructure environments

DevOps & Automation

* Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code tools
* Git-based version control
* CI/CD concepts and practical pipeline implementation
* PowerShell, Bash or Python scripting
* Deployment automation and configuration management

Customer Delivery

* Experience implementing cloud infrastructure in customer environments
* Experience participating in infrastructure migration projects
* Ability to troubleshoot independently and communicate technical issues clearly
* Technical documentation and customer handover experience

***Preferred / Additional Skills***

* Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure services
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Azure Bicep or ARM templates
* Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
* Azure landing zones and governance frameworks
* Cloud monitoring and security tools
* Experience with managed services or MSP environments
* Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimisation practices
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity environments

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* 4-7 years of relevant infrastructure, cloud engineering or DevOps experience.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Experience executing customer-facing cloud infrastructure or migration projects.
* Practical experience with scripting, automation and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with architects, project managers and customer

***Preferred Certifications***

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate
* Relevant AWS certifications

Certifications are desirable; demonstrated hands-on delivery capability is more important.

***Key Performance Indicators***

* Successful completion of assigned cloud implementations and migrations.
* Delivery against agreed project milestones and technical requirements.
* Quality, reliability and security of implemented cloud environments.
* Reduction in manual deployment effort through automation.
* **Quality and completeness of technical documentation and handover.**
* Timely resolution of implementation defects and technical escalations.
* **Customer satisfaction and successful project acceptance.**
* Contribution to reusable deployment standards and internal knowledge development.
* **Cloud optimisation and operational improvement recommendations.**

***What We Offer***

* Opportunity to help build ConceptNXT’s Cloud & Managed Services practice.
* Exposure to enterprise cloud infrastructure, migration and automation projects.
* Collaboration with infrastructure, cybersecurity and emerging technology teams.
* Opportunities for technical certifications and professional development.
* Career progression toward Senior Cloud Engineer, Cloud Architect or technical practice leadership roles.

Work Location: Bangalore - Office and customer locations as required.

Employment Type: Full-time.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

a7e7b15e.title: Delivery Manager (Technical)
a7e7b15e.description:
The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

Because many of our clients are based on the US West Coast, this role includes regular late-night coverage from India so that PST clients have a responsive, accountable delivery lead during their working day.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years
* Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects
* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage
* Willingness to come to the office on short notice and to travel as business needs arise
* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

**Preferred**

* Experience with staff augmentation ? value-add delivery transformation
* Background in one or more COE domains (e.g., legacy modernization, low-code, AI, Mulesoft, Kafka, AWS/Azure, data engineering)
* Hands-on exposure to test automation, security and compliance practices, and AI-assisted development
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, or relevant cloud/DevOps certification
* Prior experience in a peer delivery model with global teams

dfde7933.title: Services Delivery Manager (Professional services Team)
dfde7933.description:
Join Check Point Software Technologies as a Delivery Manager and be part of our global mission. As leaders in the Cyber Security industry, we tackle the most complex challenges head-on. Our diverse team of passionate individuals is dedicated to innovation and excellence. We empower our clients with cutting-edge solutions, serving a growing global customer base. By joining our team, you'll have the chance to make a meaningful impact in a remote-friendly, fast-paced, and fun environment.
  
  
This role is responsible for leading operational delivery activities across the India Professional Services project delivery business, supporting consultants delivering enterprise security implementations, migrations, upgrades and customer escalations.
  
  
The environment is highly dynamic and fast paced, requiring strong operational leadership, stakeholder management and delivery governance capabilities.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Major Responsibilities**

* Create and execute efficient personnel management plans
* Keep consultants utilization at a high level to meet annual objectives
* Improve the skills of our Professional Services consultants
* Maintain and increase the technical certification of consultants on the team
* Maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, sales and SE teams
* Strive to continuously improve current service offerings and delivery governance
* Help develop additional service offerings to enhance customer value
* Own and lead customer escalations end-to-end, working directly with customers, sales, SEs, TAC and consultants to drive resolution
* Lead operational cadence calls and ensure actions are tracked through to completion
* Always strive to improve the project delivery process and reporting structure
* Conduct regular 1:1 meetings with consultants
* Identify current and future challenges relating to skills, promotion, utilization and role development
* Demonstrate strong leadership presence by driving discussions, decisions and outcomes
* Be proactive, innovative and operationally focused
* Help with consultant recruitment and hiring
* Act as the primary delivery partner to sales leadership, ensuring regular communication, alignment and execution
* Support management of critical customer cutovers, weekend activities and enterprise delivery requirements
* Drive operational forecasting, resource planning and escalation management across the India project delivery business

**Qualifications**

* Experience managing a team of technical consultants or engineers
* Strong customer service, project management and quality control skills
* Proven experience managing escalations and enterprise customer situations
* Strong resource planning and operational management skills
* Excellent leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Strong teamwork skills and attention to detail
* Experience with Check Point technologies is preferred
* Experience managing firewall migrations, enterprise implementations or large-scale delivery engagements is highly desirable
* Familiarity with technologies such as Maestro, VSX, VPN, CloudGuard and enterprise security environments is advantageous
* Ability to manage conflicts and make strong operational decisions under pressure
* Capacity to mentor and develop team members
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Additional Information**
Check Point Software Technologies is a global leader in cyber security solutions, dedicated to protecting corporate enterprises and governments worldwide. For over 30 years, our mission has been to secure the digital world for everyone, everywhere. From pioneering stateful firewalls to our AI-powered, cloud-delivered security solutions, we are committed to safeguarding organizations with an industry-leading 99.9% prevention rate.
  
  
**Our Values**
Check Point is committed to making the world a safer and more secure place, and this commitment applies to our work both on the internet and the physical world alike. We promote a safe, healthy, supportive and diverse work environment, with training and development opportunities for all employees. We achieved gender parity in our C-Suite, and we are committed to equal opportunities and equal rewards for all.

daa6af26.title: GM - Solutions and Presales for Emerging Tech
daa6af26.description:
Job Title: GM - Solutions and Presales for Emerging Tech

City: Gurugram, Chennai, Bengaluru

State/Province: Haryana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**  
The purpose of the role is to create and drive business and growth of the Sub-Practice through demand generation, solution evangelization, delivery execution and capability development.

**͏**
-----

**Do**  
**1. Develop and deploy business strategy for the Sub-Practice aligned to the SL and Practice strategy**  
a. Establish Focus Areas, business priorities and portfolio choices for the Sub- Practice
  
i. Interact with the clients, advisors, partners and Wipro BUs to understand market trends, client expectations, competition offerings and solutions in the market
  
ii. Review the current practice portfolio and solution or client propositions provided to the clients
  
iii. Anticipate the future trends and capabilities/ solutions required by the market
  
iv. Synthesize the multiple inputs to develop the competitive service offerings and priorities
  
v. Interact with BU/ Geography leadership and sales team to drive strategic focus on the sub-practice
  
vi. Develop business plan for the sub-practice aligned to the revenue targets of the Practice/ SL
  
vii. Develop resource / manpower plans for the Sub-Practice aligned to the growth strategy and confirmed / pipeline opportunities
  
b. Drive strategic partnership with the key Vendor Partner (SAP/Oracle/MS etc.)
  
i. Align the business growth plans over the next 2-3 years with the vendor s (MS/SAP etc.) business strategy
  
ii. Nurture vendor relationships to affect technology collaboration and combined go-to-market partnership opportunities
  
c. Review and drive the execution of the strategy and business plan for the Sub- Practice
  
i. Monitor demand pipeline MIS and conduct regular cadence calls with the sales teams to review target achievement.
  
ii. Support BU/ Geography sales teams by bringing the technical expertise and thought leadership to influence and shape client s thinking of the solution
  
iii. Conduct regular cadence calls and dashboard reviews to review delivery and people metrices
  
iv. Conduct monthly review for key accounts with Delivery Unit teams (for SL/DU)
  
v. Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
  
vi. Participate in regular business reviews with Leadership and share Practice performance across revenue, growth, operational and capability parameters

  

**͏**
-----

**2. Drive focus on demand generation through market differentiation**  
a. Drive Go-To-Market strategy for the Sub-Practice
  
i. Lead the shaping of value proposition and branding of the sub-practice to aid selling
  
ii. Direct the team to make effective decisions regarding target markets, offering, distribution and client relationship management
  
iii. Help prioritize and budget for marketing related events and activities
  
iv. Lead development of product marketing plan and business case for key offerings to enable solution led sales
  
v. Identify push and pull tactics to be used for demand generation
  
b. Educate sales teams, BU client servicing team and client teams about sub-Practice s offerings and differentiation
  
c. Drive building of sales pipeline through upstream Consulting services
  
i. Build Advisory and Consulting capabilities in identified technical and functional domain areas for niche differentiation
  
ii. Grow consulting led sales to develop higher value revenue streams
  
d. Drive positive market perception through Thought Leadership in own domain
  
i. Manage relationships with Analysts and Industry groups in order to proactively shape market s perception of Wipro s strength in the practice domain
  
ii. Formalize and drive targets for analyst rankings, client testimonials and partner credits to attain market referencability and recognition
  
iii. Represent Wipro in industry forums in the practice domain (e.g. Microsoft/ SAP etc.) to gain and retain high mindshare of key vendor partners
  
iv. Be the voice of Wipro s Thought Leadership in the Practice domain by speaking in industry forums, seminars, writing blogs, articles, whitepapers etc.
  
v. Partner with BUs and alliance partners to conduct events, develop presentations or other materials to present thought leadership in client forums

  

**͏**
-----

**3. Drive focus on revenue and growth**  
a. Collaborate with SL /Practice Leaders to proactively mine existing client accounts to increase account run-rates and convert competition share
  
b. Plan, track and forge growth via new account opening. Support sales hunting effort to acquire new logos
  
c. Drive Pre-Sales processes to help increase win-rate and generate new revenue
  
i. Lead dedicated and integrated (with SL/ Practice) pre-sales to bring in industry, functional and commercial specialization to deals
  
ii. Consult with architects and senior level IT managers to assess and enhance current solution strategies and pre-sales material
  
iii. Guide the team to design appropriate solutions for client proposals and produce clear, concise and technically accurate responses to RFPs
  
iv. Approve key proposals and RFP responses before submitting to clients
  
v. Work with sales team to provide pre-sales support activities such as RFP response, doing use case demonstrations, and participating in the customer calls to sell solutions
  
d. Structure high value/ strategic deals (for Sub- Practice DU)
  
i. Engage across multiple capabilities/ ecosystems to structure the solution and the deal
  
ii. Engage with advisors to seek input and strengthen the deal with differentiated and value-added offerings
  
iii. Interact with client to keep them engaged in the development of the solution and the deal
  
iv. Lead negotiations on commercial terms for them to ensure revenue flow and profitability
  
e. Drive Alliances and Partnerships charter to increase inorganic growth
  
i. Work with Strategy group to evaluate vendor partners for M&A and partnership related opportunities
  
ii. Identify and suggest on ventures investments to create deeper market penetration opportunities
  
iii. Develop and maintain 360-degree transactional and strategic relationships with alliance partners
  
f. Drive revenues from Solutions and IPs
  
i. Develop revenue plan via solutions, enable tracking and management of the plan
  
ii. Review and approve business case and investment for IPs and solutions. Envision viable proof of concepts
  
iii. Plan and drive targets from sales of SaaS based offerings
  
g. Monitor and review the execution of deals in the Sub-Practice DU as per defined quality and process standards
  
h. Track and review revenue across stages from order booking to order fulfilment to invoicing to revenue realization for own practice
  
i. Support in managing and resolving complex client escalations to mitigate revenue leakages or opportunity losses

**͏**
-----

**4. Lead Delivery Assurance and Delivery Management in the sub-Practice**  
a. Conduct due diligence for the proposals/ deals to ensure feasibility and assurance of delivery
  
b. Review effective technical scope management and solutioning in the sub-practice
  
c. Review the delivery plans and partner with the Practice Delivery Head (PDH) s to ensure alignment with the growth strategy
  
d. Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS and key metrices (utilization, onsite/offshore billing, billing efficiency etc) across Practice to track progress and identify potential red flags
  
e. Manage and support resolution of client escalations related to delivery for projects in the Practice DU
  
f. Plan and drive initiatives and actions to be taken up at a Practice level to achieve cost optimization and improve service standards
  
g. Drive development of a framework to kick-start a project with a client (or BU) to ensure green start and maintenance
  
h. Drive assembly of the right team for the deliver on an engagement by providing clarity and support to delivery/WMG team in identification of appropriate resources for client interfacing roles as required
  
i. Drive delivery led growth across projects by leveraging differentiated value propositions and value add offering for a higher share of client s business

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.

Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

5a75a704.title: Engagement Manager II
5a75a704.description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager II**
**Does working with cutting-edge technology excite you?**
**Do you thrive in a fast paced and creative environment?**
**Join our prestigious Global Services Team**
Our customer-centric team builds innovative and tailored solutions for our customers to help them achieve their vision. We collaborate to understand our customer needs and, deliver results enabling them to grow and to succeed. We build trusted relationships through clear communication, honesty and listening to our customers.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
In this role you will maximize value, retention, and growth throughout the customer lifecycle. You will help build, innovate, and evolve customers' performance and security strategies. Becoming an industry expert, you will be delivering innovative outcomes for customers through trusted relationships, business acumen, and operational focus.
  
  
As an Engagement Manager II, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Being the strategist and technical advisor to architects and technology leaders of Akamai's Premium customers
* Partnering with Sales and pre-sales to make recommendations that expand adoption of Akamai's products and services
* Maximizing customer satisfaction, retention, and growth based on the customer's needs and business requirements
* Being the central point of contact for the customer and lead account team to deliver customer success
* Responding to escalations when various product, platform or implementation arise and identifying improvements to mitigate future risks
* Being the customer champion internally, and influencing internal decisions within teams to help customer outcomes

**Do What You Love**
To be successful in this role you will:
  
  

* Have 6 to 8 years of experience and a Bachelor's degree in computer science/Engineering or relevant fields.
* Be a customer advocate passionate about delivering technical solutions
* Have knowledge of internet technologies and online industry including HTTPS, DNS, DevOps, Web Development and Web Security
* Demonstrate good understanding or prior experience of working with CDNs
* Demonstrate experience in a customer-facing role within the Information Technology industry
* Demonstrate communication skills and an ability to build trusting relationships with customers across various levels
* Be a team player, able to collaborate, prioritize, and solve problems in a fast-changing environment
* Demonstrate experience in Program or Project management in a cross functional and technical team

**Build your career at Akamai**
Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.
  
  
With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.
  
  
**Learn more**
Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

38f13760.title: Technical Program Manager II
38f13760.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Technical Program Manager IIWho is Mastercard:  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
  
Overview:  
Mastercard's Payment Networks organization is seeking a Technical Program Manager II to join the Authorization team. The successful candidate will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Operations and other cross-functional teams to drive delivery of strategic and operational initiatives supporting Mastercard's Authorization platform.  
This role is responsible for planning, coordinating and governing the execution of complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and stakeholder groups. The Technical Program Manager II will drive delivery excellence through strong program management practices, proactive risk management, dependency coordination, stakeholder communication and release governance.  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical acumen with exceptional communication and organizational skills and is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-paced payments environment.  
  
Role  
The Technical Program Manager II will:  
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.  
Drive program governance, execution tracking and delivery reporting for strategic authorization platform initiatives.  
Facilitate PI Planning, release planning, sprint governance and cross-team execution reviews.  
Manage dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and blockers to ensure successful delivery outcomes.  
Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations and supporting organizations.  
Proactively identify, track and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions and constraints.  
Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Product Managers to prioritize work, secure resources, establish milestones, and optimize delivery sequencing.  
Ensure alignment between business objectives, product priorities and engineering execution plans.  
Drive stakeholder communication and provide executive-ready status reporting.  
Partner with engineering leadership to improve predictability, transparency and delivery efficiency.  
Support release readiness activities, production implementation planning and operational readiness reviews.  
Ensure program execution aligns with Mastercard technology and governance standards.  
Promote continuous improvement and delivery excellence across engineering teams.  
  
All About You  
Required Qualifications  
Experience managing medium-to-large technical programs in software engineering organizations.  
Demonstrated success coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and teams.  
Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies and software delivery lifecycles.  
Experience managing program schedules, milestones, dependencies and risks.  
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational capabilities.  
Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.  
Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.  
Experience using Jira, Confluence and Agile planning tools.  
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.  
Preferred Qualifications  
Experience within payments, financial technology or transaction processing environments.  
Knowledge of authorization processing, card payments, payment networks, acquiring or issuing ecosystems.  
Experience supporting large-scale distributed systems and highly available platforms.  
Experience with SAFe, PI Planning or large-scale Agile delivery frameworks.  
Experience with release management, production readiness and operational governance practices.  
Understanding of software engineering metrics and delivery analytics.  
Prior experience managing programs across globally distributed teams.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

b4425e32.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
b4425e32.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Technical Program ManagerOverview  
The Mastercard Authentication Program powers consumer authentication experiences across e-commerce and in-store payment ecosystems. As part of this mission, the engineering team ensures our authentication platforms remain highly available, performant, scalable, resilient, and operationally efficient while supporting rapid product innovation and growth.  
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive reliability-focused programs across our authentication products. This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, SRE, Product, Business Operations, and Platform teams and is responsible for leading strategic initiatives that improve platform health, operational maturity, release excellence, and customer experience. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise with strong understanding of cloud-scale distributed systems, operational excellence, resiliency engineering, performance management, capacity planning, and large-scale release coordination.  
  
If you are passionate about building highly reliable systems that power billions of secure transactions globally, this role is for you.  
  
Responsibilities:  

* Facilitate and oversee team Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Coordinate resource planning and capacity allocation across the SRE and engineering team to balance operational commitments, incident response, technical debt reduction, and strategic initiatives.
* Drive backlog prioritization and dependency management across multiple Scrum teams to ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Own end-to-end release governance across the broader authentication program. Identify opportunities to improve release processes, planning accuracy, dependency management, and overall delivery efficiency across teams.
* Understand the needs of the engineers and teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system.
* Identify dependencies, remove execution blockers, and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
* Drive strategic programs focused on improving platform availability, resiliency, reliability, and operational maturity.
* Partner with SRE and Engineering teams to identify reliability risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Establish structured review mechanisms for reliability, resiliency, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
* Champion engineering best practices including observability, automation, self-healing, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.
* Coordinate major releases, platform upgrades, migrations, and production rollouts involving multiple engineering teams.
* Manage release risks, dependencies, issue resolution, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication.
* Drive automation initiatives that improve reliability and reduce operational overhead.
* Influence technical and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.

  
Experience  

* Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and modern platform engineering practices.
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
* Experience driving capacity planning, performance engineering, disaster recovery, and operational readiness initiatives.
* Proven experience managing large cross-functional release programs across multiple teams.
* Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Proven track record of data driven decision-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
* Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
* Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, SQL/NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
* 6+ years technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
