f4c9a969.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

128474a4.title: GridBeats™ NPI Program Manager
128474a4.description:
Why GE Vernova – Grid Automation & Software?
  
At GE Vernova, we are leading the electrification of the world, helping to ensure a reliable and sustainable energy future. Our Grid Automation & Software business is at the forefront of this mission, providing critical solutions for monitoring, controlling, protecting and optimizing electrical grids.
  
Role Summary:
  
As the Sensing & Diagnostics NPI Program Manager, you will lead the execution of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, ensuring rigorous planning and proactive management of risks and opportunities across the product lifecycle. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams to translate strategic goals into actionable delivery plans.
  
Your program portfolio will span multiple concurrent NPI initiatives across the Sensing & Diagnostics product line, which brings together Monitoring & Diagnostics (M&D), GridBeats™ Asset Management, and GridBeats™ Substation Monitoring, a newly created product line combining deep domain expertise across both hardware-driven diagnostics and software-based asset performance management. Programs will range from incremental enhancements to breakthrough innovations.
  
This role is ideal for a certified program management professional who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments and is passionate about delivering high-impact solutions at the intersection of hardware, software, and grid intelligenc

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end execution of NPI programs from initiation through commercial launch.
* Drive execution across multiple lifecycle phases in compliance with stage-gate governance and development processes.
* Establish and maintain integrated program plans covering technical development, industrialization, validation, certification, manufacturing readiness, and commercial launch.
* Define program execution strategies that optimize delivery performance across concurrent product introductions.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate activities across Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Services.
* Manage inter-workstream dependencies, ensuring alignment of schedules, deliverables, and critical milestones.
* Remove execution barriers and facilitate timely decision-making across the organization.

**Program Governance**

* Organize program reviews, gate reviews, executive updates, and steering committee meetings.
* Monitor program health through KPIs, milestone tracking, budget monitoring, and schedule adherence.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and governance requirements are met throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Champion continuous improvement of NPI governance, execution methodologies, and program management practices across the portfolio

**Risk & Issue Management**

* Identify technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, supply chain, and resource risks.
* Drive mitigation plans and escalate critical issues when required to protect program objectives.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program risk registers.

**Resource & Portfolio Coordination**

* Coordinate resource planning across multiple concurrent development programs.
* Partner with functional leaders to resolve resource conflicts and optimize execution.
* Support portfolio prioritization in close collaboration with Product Management leadership.

**Product Launch Readiness**

* Coordinate cross-functional readiness activities for product launches, including manufacturing readiness, training, documentation, certifications, product data, service enablement, and commercial release.
* Ensure all launch criteria are satisfied before market introduction.
* Support smooth transition from development into sustaining operations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary execution focal point for assigned programs.
* Provide regular status reporting, executive dashboards, and actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Build strong collaborative relationships across global and regional teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
* Minimum 10 years of experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing complex NPI, Product Development, or Technical Program Management initiatives.
* Demonstrated success delivering cross-functional programs in industrial, electrical, software, automation, or energy industries.
* Strong understanding of product development lifecycles and stage-gate methodologies.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with globally distributed teams.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct organizational authority.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to balance technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or equivalent).
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.

* Experience with enterprise SW programs, Agile practices, and global product launches.
* Experience working within matrix organizations and multinational engineering environments.
* Familiarity with industrial operations, asset management, and predictive analytics is a plus.
* Experience in electrical utilities, smart grid, or industrial IoT is strongly advantageous.

5374995a.title: Technical Program Manager
5374995a.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives
* Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership
* Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program
* Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets
* Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines
* Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations
* Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews
* Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling
* Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role
* A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs
* Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus
* Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations
* Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong relationship-building skills: you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan
* A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

0b733331.title: Program Manager, Manufacturing & Supply AI Transformation
0b733331.description:
Job title: Program Manager, Manufacturing & Supply AI Transformation
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
About the job:
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive the execution of Opella’s Manufacturing & Supply Data and AI Transformation. This role focuses on translating strategy into action — coordinating cross-regional initiatives, accelerating delivery, and embedding AI-enabled capabilities across the global Manufacturing & Supply network.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong operator who brings a passion for AI and technology advancement, thrives in complex environments, and excels at orchestrating large-scale transformation programs with speed and focus. Operating at the heart of the MS.AI Factory, you will convert strategy and a live use-case pipeline into adopted, value-generating solutions across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
Program Execution & Delivery
  
  
Lead the end-to-end execution of Data & AI initiatives across Manufacturing & Supply — from use-case intake and feasibility assessment through delivery, deployment, and adoption.
  
  
Manage the project portfolio, ensuring alignment with transformation priorities and milestone achievement.
  
  
Drive a high speed of execution through active issue resolution, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
Operational Leadership
  
  
Translate strategic direction into clear implementation plans and structured execution frameworks.
  
  
Partner across functions — Manufacturing, Supply, IT, Data Science, Quality, and Finance — to ensure operational readiness and cohesion.
  
  
Maintain disciplined governance across risk management, reporting, and resource planning.
  
  
Challenger Mindset & Innovation
  
  
Challenge existing processes constructively and introduce innovative, data-driven ways of working.
  
  
Advocate for modern digital solutions and emerging technologies — including AI, agents, and automation — to drive meaningful improvement.
  
  
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management
  
  
Engage stakeholders across Europe and India to ensure alignment, collaboration, and adoption.
  
  
Lead change efforts to embed AI, automation, and analytics into operational processes — including Copilot enablement and the AI Champions network.
  
  
Provide clear communication to leadership on progress, risks, and realized benefits.
  
  
About you:
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Software & AI Engineering: Strong hands-on development skills (Python), with production-ready software engineering practices — OOP, coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
  
  
Agentic AI & GenAI: Experience designing and deploying LLM-powered and agentic solutions (RAG, autonomous and multi-agent systems), with MCP-based integrations, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
  
  
System Integration: Proven ability to integrate solutions directly into enterprise systems via APIs; exposure to MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) and manufacturing / supply chain data.
  
  
MLOps / AgentOps: Experience operationalizing models and agents — automated build / test / deploy, monitoring, and observability (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow or similar; GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
  
  
Cloud & Data: Comfortable in cloud and high-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines.
  
  
Business Understanding: Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents.
  
  
Experience: [Add required years] of hands-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus.
  
  
Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  
  
Education
  
  
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, Engineering, Data/AI) preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
8+ years of experience managing large-scale transformation or digital programs.
  
  
Strong exposure to Manufacturing & Supply environments, preferably global or regulated.
  
  
Demonstrated experience deploying data, analytics, automation, or AI capabilities at scale.
  
  
Leadership Requirements
  
  
Passion for AI & Technology Advancement: demonstrated enthusiasm for new digital technologies and their application in operational environments.
  
  
Speed & Agility: proven ability to simplify, prioritize, and deliver rapidly.
  
  
Challenger Mindset: constructively challenges historical norms and introduces innovative alternatives.
  
  
Influence & Collaboration: effective working across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.
  
  
Execution Excellence: strong structure, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  
  
Comfort with Ambiguity: navigates shifting priorities and complex environments confidently.
  
  
Technical Requirements
  
  
AI/ML Lifecycle: understanding of model development, deployment, and monitoring.
  
  
Frameworks & Tools: familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data engineering tools (SQL, Python, Spark).
  
  
Cloud & Governance: experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise data governance.
  
  
Business Translation: ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and operational outcomes.
  
  
Soft & Behavioral Skills
  
  
Challenger Mindset: proactively questions the status quo and drives innovation and pace across the transformation portfolio.
  
  
All In, Together: builds strong, collaborative relationships across global, cross-functional, and partner teams.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: relentlessly focused on delivering measurable business impact and realized benefits, not just activity.
  
  
Courageous: takes ownership, makes decisions in ambiguity, and drives initiatives through to completion.
  
  
Radically Simple: brings clarity and simplicity to complex programs, stakeholders, and reporting.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role is critical to accelerating Opella’s digital capability across Manufacturing & Supply. The Program Manager will ensure strategic direction is executed effectively, driving measurable improvements across Europe, India, and the broader global network.
  
  
Why us?
  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
  
  
www.opella.com/en/careers

9e732bf6.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
9e732bf6.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview**
The Mastercard Authentication Program powers consumer authentication experiences across e-commerce and in-store payment ecosystems. As part of this mission, the engineering team ensures our authentication platforms remain highly available, performant, scalable, resilient, and operationally efficient while supporting rapid product innovation and growth.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive reliability-focused programs across our authentication products. This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, SRE, Product, Business Operations, and Platform teams and is responsible for leading strategic initiatives that improve platform health, operational maturity, release excellence, and customer experience. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise with strong understanding of cloud-scale distributed systems, operational excellence, resiliency engineering, performance management, capacity planning, and large-scale release coordination.
  
  
If you are passionate about building highly reliable systems that power billions of secure transactions globally, this role is for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Facilitate and oversee team Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Coordinate resource planning and capacity allocation across the SRE and engineering team to balance operational commitments, incident response, technical debt reduction, and strategic initiatives.
* Drive backlog prioritization and dependency management across multiple Scrum teams to ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Own end-to-end release governance across the broader authentication program. Identify opportunities to improve release processes, planning accuracy, dependency management, and overall delivery efficiency across teams.
* Understand the needs of the engineers and teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system.
* Identify dependencies, remove execution blockers, and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
* Drive strategic programs focused on improving platform availability, resiliency, reliability, and operational maturity.
* Partner with SRE and Engineering teams to identify reliability risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Establish structured review mechanisms for reliability, resiliency, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
* Champion engineering best practices including observability, automation, self-healing, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.
* Coordinate major releases, platform upgrades, migrations, and production rollouts involving multiple engineering teams.
* Manage release risks, dependencies, issue resolution, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication.
* Drive automation initiatives that improve reliability and reduce operational overhead.
* Influence technical and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.

**Experience**

* Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and modern platform engineering practices.
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
* Experience driving capacity planning, performance engineering, disaster recovery, and operational readiness initiatives.
* Proven experience managing large cross-functional release programs across multiple teams.
* Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Proven track record of data driven decision-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
* Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
* Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, SQL/NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
* 6+ years technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

8a6b8bca.title: Program Manager 4
8a6b8bca.description:
**Job Description**
The IC3 TPM owns defined GPU cluster health workstreams and drives day-to-day execution for assigned customers, shapes, locations, repair programs, or partner actions. This role tracks availability, repair workflow adherence, operational KPIs, risks, issues, dependencies, and program milestones. The role is accountable for crisp execution, reliable status, early risk identification, and disciplined escalation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Customer and Cluster Availability Tracking**

* Own availability tracking for assigned customer clusters defined by shape/location.
* Monitor performance against the 97.5% availability target and identify clusters trending below target.
* Maintain weekly views of unavailable hosts, long-running repairs, reopen rates, repair aging, spare constraints, and repair throughput.
* Track repair progress through standard repair workflow states, including CPV/ Warminator , TRS/CPV Tier 1, DO/CHS, release, termination, and customer handoff.

**Program Execution**

* Manage assigned repair improvement programs with clear scope, milestones, owners, risks, and status.
* Drive execution of targeted programs such as proactive unavailable-host reduction, repair workflow adherence, RMA/spares follow-up, and partner action tracking.
* Coordinate with SDE/SRE teams to ensure tooling, triage, and first-level support gaps are visible and prioritized.
* Escalate blockers where repair SLAs, availability goals, or customer commitments are at risk.

**KPI and Reporting Support**

* Support definition and tracking of business and operational KPIs, including availability, billability, revenue impact, repair success, repair efficacy, reopen rates, new tickets, and throughput.
* Maintain dashboards, weekly reports, status summaries, and action registers.
* Partner with engineering and data teams to improve reports, dashboards, forecasts, and tooling.
* Provide structured input into leadership, customer, and internal team updates.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Facilitate working sessions across TPMs, SDE/SRE, partner teams, and repair execution teams.
* Document decisions, risks, open actions, and follow-ups.
* Ensure stakeholders understand current repair status, next steps, and escalation path.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

c57fedf7.title: GridBeats™ NPI Program Manager
c57fedf7.description:
**Job Description Summary**
Why GE Vernova – Grid Automation & Software?
  
  
At GE Vernova, we are leading the electrification of the world, helping to ensure a reliable and sustainable energy future. Our Grid Automation & Software business is at the forefront of this mission, providing critical solutions for monitoring, controlling, protecting and optimizing electrical grids.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As the Sensing & Diagnostics NPI Program Manager, you will lead the execution of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, ensuring rigorous planning and proactive management of risks and opportunities across the product lifecycle. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams to translate strategic goals into actionable delivery plans.
  
  
Your program portfolio will span multiple concurrent NPI initiatives across the Sensing & Diagnostics product line, which brings together Monitoring & Diagnostics (M&D), GridBeats™ Asset Management, and GridBeats™ Substation Monitoring, a newly created product line combining deep domain expertise across both hardware-driven diagnostics and software-based asset performance management. Programs will range from incremental enhancements to breakthrough innovations.
  
  
This role is ideal for a certified program management professional who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments and is passionate about delivering high-impact solutions at the intersection of hardware, software, and grid intelligenc
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end execution of NPI programs from initiation through commercial launch.
* Drive execution across multiple lifecycle phases in compliance with stage-gate governance and development processes.
* Establish and maintain integrated program plans covering technical development, industrialization, validation, certification, manufacturing readiness, and commercial launch.
* Define program execution strategies that optimize delivery performance across concurrent product introductions.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate activities across Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Services.
* Manage inter-workstream dependencies, ensuring alignment of schedules, deliverables, and critical milestones.
* Remove execution barriers and facilitate timely decision-making across the organization.

**Program Governance**

* Organize program reviews, gate reviews, executive updates, and steering committee meetings.
* Monitor program health through KPIs, milestone tracking, budget monitoring, and schedule adherence.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and governance requirements are met throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Champion continuous improvement of NPI governance, execution methodologies, and program management practices across the portfolio

**Risk & Issue Management**

* Identify technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, supply chain, and resource risks.
* Drive mitigation plans and escalate critical issues when required to protect program objectives.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program risk registers.

**Resource & Portfolio Coordination**

* Coordinate resource planning across multiple concurrent development programs.
* Partner with functional leaders to resolve resource conflicts and optimize execution.
* Support portfolio prioritization in close collaboration with Product Management leadership.

**Product Launch Readiness**

* Coordinate cross-functional readiness activities for product launches, including manufacturing readiness, training, documentation, certifications, product data, service enablement, and commercial release.
* Ensure all launch criteria are satisfied before market introduction.
* Support smooth transition from development into sustaining operations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary execution focal point for assigned programs.
* Provide regular status reporting, executive dashboards, and actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Build strong collaborative relationships across global and regional teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
* Minimum 10 years of experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing complex NPI, Product Development, or Technical Program Management initiatives.
* Demonstrated success delivering cross-functional programs in industrial, electrical, software, automation, or energy industries.
* Strong understanding of product development lifecycles and stage-gate methodologies.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with globally distributed teams.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct organizational authority.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to balance technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or equivalent).
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.

**Preferred Characteristics**

* Master's in Business Administration (MBA), Operations or related discipline.
* Experience with enterprise SW programs, Agile practices, and global product launches.
* Experience working within matrix organizations and multinational engineering environments.
* Familiarity with industrial operations, asset management, and predictive analytics is a plus.
* Experience in electrical utilities, smart grid, or industrial IoT is strongly advantageous.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Execution-Focused – Drives clarity, urgency, and accountability across teams.
* Structured Thinker – Breaks down complexity into manageable, actionable plans.
* Agile Champion – Promotes Agile principles and adapts delivery models to team needs.
* Collaborative Partner – Builds trust and alignment across functions and levels.
* Resilient Problem Solver – Navigates ambiguity and resolves issues proactively.
* Customer-Oriented – Keeps end-user outcomes in mind throughout execution.
* Global Mindset – Comfortable working across cultures and time zones.

Join us and be part of a mission-driven team redefining sensing & diagnostics for the energy transition. Help utilities unlock the full potential of their infrastructure while advancing toward a cleaner, smarter, and more resilient energy future.

Yes

11bb5b30.description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic and technically savvy individual to join our team as an IT Pre-Sales Product Specialist.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting pre-sales activities by leveraging your technical expertise to enhance marketing strategies and facilitate customer engagements. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of IT solutions, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Technical Support: Provide pre-sales technical assistance to the sales team and customers, including product demonstrations, presentations, and solution consultations.

· Marketing Collaboration: Work closely with the digital marketing team to develop compelling technical content for marketing campaigns, including case studies, and blog posts.

· Customer Engagement: Engage with potential clients to understand their technical requirements, demonstrate product capabilities, and articulate value propositions.

· Sales Enablement: Equip the sales team with technical knowledge and tools necessary to effectively position our IT solutions in the market.

· Market Analysis: Conduct research on industry trends, competitor offerings, and customer needs to contribute to product positioning and go-to-market strategies.

· Content Development: Create and maintain technical collateral such as product datasheets, solution briefs, and technical presentations.

· Product Expertise: Stay updated on our product portfolio and industry developments to effectively communicate features, benefits, and use cases to customers.

· Customer Advocacy: Serve as a technical advocate for customers, ensuring their requirements are understood and addressed during the pre-sales process.

**Desired Skills and Qualifications:**

* CloudSEK **XVigil** constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will work as part of a Research and Development team. You will build verification components, constrained-random testing, system testing, and drive verification closure. You will verify digital designs, collaborate closely with design and verification engineers on projects, and perform direct verification. You will build constrained-random verification environments that exercise designs through their corner-cases and expose all types of bugs. You will manage the full life-cycle of verification, which can range from verification planning, test execution, to collecting and closing coverage.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Plan the verification of digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
* Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM), or formally verify designs with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools.
* Identify and write all types of coverage measures for corner-cases.
* Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
* Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

3949a383.title: SOC Engineer — Integration & Presales
3949a383.description:
**Company Description**
CrossCipher delivers an advanced Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service that goes beyond traditional Security Operations Center (SOC) offerings by providing comprehensive threat intelligence, proactive threat hunting, continuous security monitoring, incident analysis, and incident response. Instead of relying solely on rules and signatures, CrossCipher uses advanced security analytics across endpoints, user behavior, applications, and networks to achieve deeper and more accurate threat detection. The MDR platform leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning to accelerate investigations, automatically contain threats, and orchestrate coordinated responses. This approach enables organizations to respond faster to emerging risks while improving overall security posture and operational resilience. Candidates joining CrossCipher will contribute to a modern, technology-driven security environment focused on innovation and impact.

**Role Description**

**Client Integration Responsibilities / Onboarding & Platform Integration**
•

Lead the technical onboarding of new clients onto the SOC platform — from scoping and discovery through to full go-live • Configure data source integrations including syslog forwarding, API connectors, firewall log ingestion, and cloud log pipelines • Deploy, configure, and validate XDR agents across client Windows and Linux endpoints • Create client-specific SIEM rules, dashboards, and alert policies tailored to their environment • Coordinate with client IT teams to ensure network access, firewall exceptions, and proxy settings are correctly configured • Conduct onboarding handover sessions and produce integration documentation for both client and internal SOC teams

We are seeking a technically strong and client-oriented SOC Engineer to own the end-to-end onboarding of new clients onto our SOC platform, support presales technical engagements, and ensure the successful deployment and operation of XDR agents across diverse client environments. You will serve as a key bridge between our sales team and the technical operations team — translating client needs into working security solutions while troubleshooting issues across Windows and Linux environments.

**XDR Agent Troubleshooting**
• Diagnose and resolve XDR agent installation failures, connectivity issues, and performance problems on Windows and Linux systems • Analyze agent logs, Windows Event Viewer entries, and Linux system journals (journalctl / syslog) to identify root causes • Troubleshoot common Windows issues: Group Policy conflicts, service failures, registry misconfigurations, and AV exclusion errors

Troubleshoot common Linux issues: package dependencies, SELinux/AppArmor policies, daemon failures, and permission errors • Document recurring issues and develop step-by-step remediation runbooks for the support team • Escalate unresolved technical issues to the vendor with full diagnostic detail and follow through to resolution.

**Responsibilities Handover**

• Support the sales team in technical presales engagements — delivering platform demos, proof-of-concept setups, and architecture walkthroughs • Prepare and deliver technical presentations tailored to the client's industry, size, and security maturity level • Respond to RFP/RFI technical sections, security questionnaires, and due diligence requests from prospects • Clearly articulate the value of XDR, SIEM, and SOC-as-a-Service offerings to both technical and non technical audiences • Conduct gap analysis and security assessments for prospective clients to define a clear integration roadmap • Build trusted relationships with client technical stakeholders during the pre-contract phase • Provide post-demo feedback to the product team based on client objections and feature requests.

**Core SOC Responsibilities**
• Monitor and triage security alerts across SIEM, EDR, and network platforms during assigned shifts • Investigate incidents following established runbooks and escalate to L2/L3 as appropriate • Develop and tune SIEM correlation rules and alerting thresholds to reduce false positives • Produce clear incident reports and post-incident documentation • Participate in threat hunting activities and stay current on emerging TTPs via threat intelligence feeds • Mentor L1 analysts and provide escalation support and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications Security & SOC**
• 2–4 years of experience in a SOC, security engineering, or IT security role • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or QRadar • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to detection logic • Experience deploying and managing XDR or EDR agents (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar).

**Windows & Linux Troubleshooting**
• Solid Windows troubleshooting skills: Event Viewer, Services, Registry Editor, Group Policy, Task Scheduler, PowerShell • Solid Linux troubleshooting skills: systemctl, journalctl, file permissions, cron, SELinux/AppArmor, package managers (apt/yum) • Ability to read and interpret system and application logs to logically trace and resolve client-reported issues • Comfortable working via SSH and remote desktop in headless or restricted client environments.

**Client-Facing & Communication**
• Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders • Experience delivering technical presentations, demos, or training to external clients or partners • Strong written communication skills for producing integration guides, runbooks, and client-facing reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**
• Industry certifications: CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, GCIH, or vendor-specific XDR/SIEM certifications • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native security integrations • Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash for deployment automation and log parsing • Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automated playbook creation • Background in MSP/MSSP environments with multi-tenant platform management experience • Prior presales, solutions engineering, or technical account management experience • Active security clearance or eligibility to obtain clearance .

**What We Offer**

• Competitive salary with performance and client acquisition bonuses

• Career growth path toward Senior SOC Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Threat Intelligence roles

• Collaborative team culture with access to cutting-edge security tooling

Job Description

We are looking for a highly experienced **IBM i Strategic Solutions Architect** based in the United States who can serve as a senior technical advisor for some of our largest and most strategic IBM i clients.

This person will work closely with client technology and business teams, spend time onsite with strategic accounts, understand their IBM i landscape and future priorities, and identify opportunities where we can provide additional value.

The role will also work closely with our offshore IBM i teams, providing architectural guidance, technical direction, and ensuring that our delivery teams remain aligned with the client's technology strategy.

This is not just an architecture or delivery role. We are looking for someone who can build strong relationships with clients, understand their technology challenges, proactively recommend solutions, and help us **grow strategic IBM i accounts**.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Client Engagement

* Act as a senior IBM i technical advisor and trusted partner for selected strategic accounts.
* Develop strong working relationships with client architects, technology leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Visit strategic clients approximately once per quarter and work onsite for 3-4 days.
* Understand the client's IBM i environment, applications, architecture, technical challenges, roadmap, and business priorities.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical discovery sessions, and modernization planning.
* Proactively bring ideas and recommendations to clients instead of waiting for requirements.

IBM i Architecture & Modernization

* Assess existing IBM i application architecture and recommend improvements.
* Provide architectural guidance around application modernization, integration, APIs, DevOps, databases, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Help clients evaluate modernization opportunities while protecting their existing investment in IBM i.
* Provide technical leadership for complex IBM i initiatives and architecture decisions.
* Guide teams on modernization of legacy RPG and COBOL applications where appropriate.

Offshore Team Leadership

* Work closely with offshore architects, technical leads, developers, and delivery teams.
* Translate client strategy and onsite discussions into clear technical direction for offshore teams.
* Conduct architecture and solution reviews with the offshore team.
* Mentor senior IBM i developers and technical leads.
* Help offshore teams better understand the client's business, architecture, and long-term technology direction.
* Act as a bridge between client stakeholders and offshore engineering teams.

Technical Background

The ideal candidate should have strong experience across the IBM i ecosystem, including:

* IBM i / AS400 architecture
* RPG, RPGLE, ILE RPG and Free-Format RPG
* DB2 for i / SQL
* CL / CLLE
* COBOL experience or good architectural understanding of COBOL applications
* IBM i application architecture and integration
* APIs, REST services and modern integration patterns
* IBM i modernization strategies
* DevOps and CI/CD concepts for IBM i
* Application analysis, impact analysis and dependency understanding
* Security, performance and system architecture concepts
* Integration of IBM i applications with distributed/cloud applications

Experience with modern UI, Java/.NET integration, cloud integration, AI-assisted modernization, or IBM i modernization products/tools would be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

Beyond technical expertise, the individual must be:

* **Strongly client-facing** and comfortable interacting with senior client technology leaders.
* Able to communicate complex IBM i concepts in simple business language.
* Consultative rather than purely delivery-focused.
* Proactive in finding problems and opportunities.
* Comfortable conducting technical discovery sessions independently.
* Capable of challenging existing approaches constructively and recommending alternatives.
* Strong at working with distributed US and offshore teams.
* Comfortable mentoring architects, leads, and developers.
* Commercially aware and able to recognize account-growth opportunities without behaving like a salesperson.
* Willing and able to travel within the US regularly.

8d1c913b.title: Solution Architect
8d1c913b.description:
**Overview**

The Solution Architect plays a critical role in bridging long-term enterprise strategy with the practical delivery of technology solutions across business domains. This role ensures that solution designs are aligned with MUFG’s strategic objectives, technology roadmaps, and enterprise architecture principles. A key responsibility is defining and evolving foundational enterprise architecture elements—such as domain models, integration patterns, data and security frameworks—that enable the organisation’s future-state architecture. The Solution Architect provides architectural oversight, fosters coherence across solution landscapes, and collaborates closely with business and technology stakeholders to support capability planning, promote reuse and standardisation, and ensure that solutions are scalable, secure, and future-ready. The role also demands a creative and pragmatic approach to leveraging cloud-native and open-source technologies—particularly within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem—to deliver innovative, cost-effective, and high-impact business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Design end-to-end solutions across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and business goals.
* Lead cloud adoption initiatives and migration strategies.
* Architect solutions using IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models.
* Apply EA frameworks to guide solution decisions.
* Present architectural solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Assess emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies.
* Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and regulatory standards.
* Promote architectural thinking and innovation.
* Contribute to the development of enterprise models and capability roadmaps that guide investment decisions and technology evolution.

Operational Management

* Maintain architectural artifacts and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with business, IT, and vendor teams to gather requirements.
* Lead on solution architecture for programmes and projects
* Conduct PoCs and feasibility studies.
* Enforce architectural governance and best practices.

People Leadership

* Guide development teams and junior architects
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and architectural trends, ensuring MUFG remains adaptive and future ready.

Governance & Risk

* Play an active role in technology governance through Architecture Governance Board (AGB).

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in solution architecture or related roles.
* Strong expertise in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and GCP although primarily Azure).
* Familiarity with EA frameworks like TOGAF, Zachman, or FEAF.
* Experience with microservices, API design, and integration patterns.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or TOGAF are a plus.
* Working in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Leading digital transformation or modernization projects.
* Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  

MUFG Pension & Market Services is a global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly.

Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences.

A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.

  

Our MUFG Corporate Markets division provides clients with a comprehensive corporate market offering that connects issuers to their stakeholders. Our uniquely integrated range of corporate markets capabilities includes shareholder management and analytics, stakeholder engagement, share and unit registry, employee share plans, and digital and print communications. We also offer company secretarial support, as well as various specialist offerings such as insolvency solutions. We operate in twelve countries throughout Australasia, Asia, Africa, the Middle East, United Kingdom and Europe.

Our teams combine a wealth of industry experience with a rigorous focus on client management to deliver a premium service underpinned by market leading digital technology provided by our Technology division.

MUFG Pension & Market Services is building a dynamic, client focused, caring and inclusive culture that is built on the foundations of an entrepreneurial spirit, effective risk management, empathy and trust, and underpinned by its core values.

We are an inclusive employer whose people work collaboratively. We encourage, support and value the various talents and perspectives of our people and promote a flexible and blended work environment where our people can thrive and their wellbeing is supported. We know that diversity drives better client outcomes, continuous improvement, and growth. Be part of the MUFG Pension & Market Services journey and together we will achieve our full potential.

We treat all individuals fairly and equitably and do not discriminate on the basis of diverse characteristics including, but not limited to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity, cultural background, physical abilities/disabilities, religious or political belief, marital or family status or carers responsibilities.

Candidates must have the relevant work rights to be considered for an opportunity at MUFG Pension & Market Services. Successful applicants will be required to complete background screening prior to commencement of employment.

25535a7f.title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
25535a7f.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)
* Experience designing generative AI, machine learning and data analytics solutions
* Experience with large-scale migration programs (1,000+ servers) using AWS migration tools and methods
* Software development experience in an object-oriented language

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra
