**Job Description – Delivery Manager**

**Location:** Gurugram, India  
**Experience:** 12–16 years, with 5+ years in delivery management  
**Function:** Technology Delivery

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with strong expertise in Agile delivery and exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled ways of working.

The role involves leading multiple Agile teams, driving predictable delivery, managing cross-functional dependencies, and improving delivery efficiency through effective processes and AI-enabled tools.

The ideal candidate will have strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery across multiple Agile teams and initiatives.

* Drive Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Ensure clear sprint goals, prioritized backlogs, and predictable execution.

* Monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, sprint predictability, and cycle time.

* Manage dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder escalations.

* Partner with Product, Engineering, QA, and global stakeholders to align priorities and delivery commitments.

* Establish effective delivery governance, reporting, and communication cadences.

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI tools for improved planning, documentation, reporting, testing, and productivity.

* Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, quality, and team effectiveness.

* Manage resource planning, capacity, and allocation across teams.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–16 years of experience in technology delivery or program management.

* 5+ years of experience managing Agile delivery across multiple teams.

* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Agile principles, and scaled Agile practices.

* Experience managing cross-functional technology teams in a global delivery environment.

* Practical exposure to AI/GenAI tools and their application in delivery workflows.

* Strong understanding of SDLC, engineering practices, and release management.

* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Agile metrics, and delivery reporting.

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent certifications.

* Experience in Agile transformation or delivery excellence initiatives.

* Exposure to AI-assisted engineering, workflow automation, or productivity improvement initiatives.

**Success Measures**

* Improved delivery predictability and team throughput.

* Effective management of dependencies and delivery risks.

* Improved stakeholder satisfaction and delivery transparency.

* Measurable productivity improvements through AI and automation.

* Improved quality and overall team effectiveness.

**Ideal Candidate**

A delivery-focused leader who combines strong Agile expertise with practical AI awareness. The candidate should be capable of leading multiple teams, driving accountability, managing complex dependencies, and delivering measurable improvements in productivity and execution.

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**

#### **Please read our Privacy Notice (****https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment****) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

30e6b285.title: Hiring CMS Architect
30e6b285.description:
Job Title: CMS Architect

**Experience:** 10 Years Overall | Minimum 7 Years Relevant Experience  
**Location:** Remote – Pan India  
**Budget:** ₹2.5 LPA  
**Engagement Model:** Direct Contract with Haparz

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CMS Architect with strong expertise in digital content architecture, enterprise content management systems, and knowledge management platforms. The ideal candidate will assess existing content ecosystems and design scalable, governed, and reusable content architectures for global websites and digital platforms.

This role focuses on content architecture, information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, content governance, localization, and knowledge management. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into practical architecture recommendations that improve content discoverability, consistency, reuse, and delivery across global markets.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess existing CMS, FAQ, and knowledge management ecosystems across global websites to identify architectural gaps, content duplication, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design scalable content models, classification frameworks, metadata structures, and information architectures that support reusable content across multiple websites and markets.
* Define taxonomy, tagging standards, and publishing workflows to improve content discoverability, consistency, governance, and traceability.
* Establish content reuse strategies, localization guidelines, and controlled content variations to support regional requirements without unnecessary duplication.
* Evaluate enterprise CMS, knowledge management systems, search capabilities, and content delivery platforms to recommend improvements and potential consolidation.
* Translate business and content requirements into architecture recommendations in collaboration with content strategists, business analysts, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Develop content lifecycle management frameworks covering creation, review, approval, publication, maintenance, archival, and retirement.
* Define governance models, content ownership, access controls, and compliance requirements for enterprise content repositories.
* Recommend approaches for multilingual content management, translation workflows, market-specific publishing, and global content consistency.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks, platform evaluation documents, architecture guidelines, and transformation roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve content search, knowledge discovery, content analytics, and omnichannel content delivery.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong experience with enterprise CMS platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Contentful, Kentico, Drupal, SharePoint, Bloomreach, or similar platforms.
* Expertise in digital content architecture, structured content modeling, and information architecture.
* Hands-on experience designing taxonomy, metadata models, tagging strategies, and content governance frameworks.
* Understanding of knowledge management systems, FAQ ecosystems, enterprise search, and knowledge discovery.
* Experience with content reuse, content lifecycle management, versioning, traceability, and publishing workflows.
* Understanding of localization, multilingual content delivery, translation management, and regional content variations.
* Ability to assess existing content platforms and develop architecture recommendations aligned with business and technical requirements.

Preferred Expertise

* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of headless CMS, composable architecture, APIs, and omnichannel content delivery.
* Experience with content analytics, search relevance, customer support knowledge bases, and content discoverability.
* Familiarity with translation management systems and market-specific governance requirements.
* Experience creating architecture roadmaps, implementation playbooks, governance documentation, and platform evaluation frameworks.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Architecture, or a related discipline.
* CMS or digital experience platform certifications are an advantage.
* Knowledge management or information architecture certifications are desirable.

Work Location: Remote

1a5c1577.title: Program Manager Edtech
1a5c1577.description:
Job Title: Program Manager – Online MBA

**Industry:** EdTech / Higher Education / Online Education  
**Department:** Centre for Distance and Online Education  
**Reporting To:** Director – Strategic Initiatives  
**Qualification:** MBA or Master's degree in a relevant field  
**Experience:** Relevant experience in program management, preferably in online education

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Program Manager to oversee the end-to-end operations and delivery of an Online MBA programme. The role involves managing student experience, academic operations, programme performance, external partnerships, admissions coordination, budgeting, and reporting.

The ideal candidate should have strong program management, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with an understanding of online learning platforms, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and student lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Program Management & Operations**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations and end-to-end delivery of the Online MBA programme.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including student engagement, retention, completion rates, and student satisfaction.
* Analyse programme performance data and implement strategies to improve operational efficiency and learner experience.
* Track individual student progress, identify at-risk learners, and coordinate appropriate intervention and support.
* Review and update programme curriculum in coordination with academic stakeholders to ensure relevance and quality.
* Develop and maintain programme websites, digital content, and online learning resources.
* Collaborate with the brand and marketing teams to develop programme-related communication and marketing materials.
* Manage programme budgets and monitor expenses to support financial sustainability.

**2. Student Experience & Support**

* Address student queries through email and other communication channels, ensuring timely resolution.
* Coordinate with academic teams, faculty members, and student support teams to enhance the overall learner experience.
* Organise student workshops, masterclasses, networking events, and other engagement activities.
* Conduct student satisfaction surveys, analyse feedback, and implement improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with career services teams to facilitate career guidance and employment-related opportunities for students.
* Ensure smooth delivery of online classes and provide support for technical or operational issues, including during weekends when required.

**3. Partner & Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including technology providers and education financing partners.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding, evaluate performance, and resolve operational issues.
* Support contract negotiations and monitor service delivery against agreed requirements.
* Work with technology and Learning Management System (LMS) teams to ensure course content management, data backup, and platform functionality.

**4. Admissions & Enrolment Management**

* Coordinate with the admissions team to ensure smooth execution of admission and enrolment processes.
* Monitor the student enrolment journey and ensure timely completion of admission formalities.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve admission-related operational issues and improve process efficiency.

**5. MIS, Reporting & Financial Coordination**

* Prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports, dashboards, and performance reports related to enrolments, student engagement, retention, and programme outcomes.
* Analyse student data and generate actionable insights to support management decisions.
* Coordinate with the finance department regarding student billing, fee payments, and outstanding dues.
* Oversee student refund processing in coordination with the finance team.
* Maintain accurate programme records, reports, and operational documentation.

**6. Stakeholder Coordination & Administration**

* Coordinate with academic, technology, finance, marketing, career services, and student support teams.
* Participate in programme review meetings and provide updates on performance, operational challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Conduct research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in online programme management.
* Develop and implement crisis communication and issue-resolution plans.
* Coordinate campus facilities and logistical arrangements for visiting guests and programme-related events.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and participate in relevant professional development activities.

Required Qualifications

* MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Education, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in programme management, project management, academic operations, or online education.
* Strong understanding of online learning platforms, digital education delivery, and student lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and coordinate cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing Online MBA programmes, distance education, higher education, or EdTech operations.
* Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), Student Information Systems (SIS), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.
* Experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, budgeting, vendor management, and student engagement initiatives.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management qualification.

Key Skills

Program Management | Online MBA Operations | EdTech | Higher Education | Online Learning | Academic Operations | Student Experience | Student Engagement | Project Management | Learning Management System (LMS) | Vendor Management | Stakeholder Management | MIS Reporting | Data Analysis | Budget Management | Admissions Management | Student Lifecycle Management | Process Improvement | Cross-Functional Coordination

Working Conditions

* Full-time role in a professional office environment.
* Flexibility to work evenings or weekends when required for online classes, student engagement activities, and programme operations.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Online Education: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

48695c1b.title: Delivery Manager
48695c1b.description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.

Must-Have Skills

Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)

772daa8a.title: Installed Base Program Manager
772daa8a.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The IB Program Manager provides end-to-end program leadership for Cardiovascular Ultrasound Installed Base initiatives. Based in India, the role partners with global stakeholders to translate customer, patient, quality, regulatory, service, supply-chain and business priorities into integrated execution plans.
  
The role owns program governance, prioritization, schedule, budget and resource visibility, cross-functional dependencies, risks and leadership escalation. The successful candidate will be operating independently across a complex global matrix and driving measurable customer, quality, lifecycle and business outcomes. Technical design authority remains with the accountable Engineering, Systems, Quality and Regulatory leaders.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end planning and execution of assigned CVUS Installed Base programs across the post-launch product lifecycle.
* Define program scope, outcomes, milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points and operating cadence.
* Create and maintain an integrated execution plan across Engineering, Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Service, Finance and Product Management.
* Build and manage a transparent IB backlog, facilitating prioritization based on patient and customer impact, safety, regulatory commitments, product quality, service burden, fulfilment, lifecycle urgency, cost and resource availability.
* Drive cross-functional execution for customer complaints and investigations, product quality issues, corrective actions, CAPA, SCR/SPR, CSO, FMI or field actions, CCN and standards updates, cybersecurity updates, product holds and recovery actions, as applicable.
* Lead sustaining execution for design changes, supplier or component changes, obsolescence, component end-of-life, continuity of supply and product lifecycle or end-of-life activities.
* Ensure effective transition from NPI into Installed Base support, with clear ownership of residual risks, sustaining commitments and field-readiness actions.
* Lead program reviews and relevant Heartbeat operating mechanisms; maintain concise dashboards covering milestones, backlog, risks, dependencies, resources, budget, customer and quality actions, and decisions.
* Actively manage program budgets, purchase orders, forecasts and actuals in partnership with budget owners and Finance.
* Maintain resource and capacity visibility, surface constraints early, and facilitate cross-functional trade-off and allocation decisions.
* Identify and mitigate program, quality, regulatory, supply, resource, schedule and implementation risks before they affect customers or commitments.
* Escalate unresolved issues with a clear problem statement, customer and business impact, options and a recommended course of action.
* Provide clear, fact-based communication to India, Horten and broader CVUS leadership, with documented decisions, owners and closure dates.
* Apply Lean and continuous-improvement principles to simplify IB execution, improve predictability and standardize effective program-management practices.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university or institution.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, program management, product development, sustaining engineering or product-lifecycle leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, global, cross-functional program in a matrix organization.
* Proven ability to convert complex technical, quality, regulatory and business issues into integrated, executable program plans.
* Strong program-management capability across scope, schedule, milestones, risk, resources, budget, dependencies, decisions and stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountable closure without direct reporting authority.
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities, urgent field or business issues and ambiguity with limited direction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise program reviews and escalation to senior leadership.
* Ability to work effectively across India, Europe and other global locations and time zones.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in regulated medical devices, healthcare technology or another highly regulated product environment.
* Working knowledge of medical-device design controls, complaints, CAPA, field actions, product risk management, regulatory compliance, design changes, running VCP programs and lifecycle or end-of-life processes.
* Experience with diagnostic ultrasound, imaging systems, electromechanical medical equipment or comparable complex hardware and software products.
* Experience leading sustaining releases, supplier and component changes, obsolescence, continuity-of-supply or product-quality improvement programs.
* Financial-management experience covering program budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, external spend and actuals.
* Lean or continuous improvement experience focused on reducing hand-offs, delays and execution variability.
* Experience using portfolio or program-management systems, operational dashboards and data-driven reviews to support decisions.

**Common Engineering Expectations:**

* Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services.
* Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability.
* Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps.
* Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.
* Automated unit, integration, API, system, performance and reliability testing.
* Strong design, coding, debugging, root-cause analysis and technical documentation practices.
* Integration challenges of third party and second party SaaS solutions.
* Working with AI-DLC and software development acceleration.

**Healthcare and Medical Device Context:**

* Experience in regulated healthcare or medical-device development is required for the Verification Lead and strongly preferred for senior architecture, automation and program roles.
* Strong knowledge on SDLC, PRD process, Risks, FMEAs.
* Awareness of patient-data privacy, cybersecurity and secure handling of clinical information.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR.
* + Experience with real-time clinical data, device connectivity, patient monitoring or high-availability clinical applications is advantageous.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

==========================

b3222881.title: Pre-sales Specialist - Cyber Security
b3222881.description:
**About VikingCloud**

VikingCloud is the leading Predict-to-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost-effective risk mitigation decisions – faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform™, the industry’s largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6+ billion online events every day.

VikingCloud is the one-stop partner trusted by 4+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.

**This Position**

Customer-facing pre-sales role responsible for discovery, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, service presentations, and ongoing support for cybersecurity and compliance opportunities.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Pre-Sales Specialist**
to support the US sales organization in managing customer-facing pre-sales activities for cybersecurity and compliance services.

This is a
**mid level pre-sales position**
involving requirements gathering, proposal development, customer presentations, RFP responses, internal coordination, service positioning, and opportunity support.

The successful candidate will be expected to understand standard cybersecurity and compliance services, communicate them clearly, organize information effectively, and coordinate with internal specialists when deeper technical input is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support sales opportunities related to managed security, cybersecurity assessments, compliance, vulnerability management, security testing, and related services.
* Participate in discovery calls to understand customer business needs, current challenges, required services, timelines, and decision criteria.
* Ask relevant follow-up questions and document customer requirements accurately.
* Prepare customer presentations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, service summaries, and statements of work.
* Map customer requirements to standard service offerings, capabilities, deliverables, and outcomes.
* Explain the scope, methodology, benefits, assumptions, and expected outputs of standard cybersecurity and compliance services.
* Present service capabilities to technical, procurement, operational, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct standard service demonstrations, walkthroughs, and capability presentations using approved materials.
* Support sales teams in preparing account-specific messaging, opportunity strategies, discovery plans, and presentation content.
* Develop clear responses to technical, operational, security, compliance, and vendor questionnaires.
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts for non-standard, highly technical, or specialized customer requirements.
* Consolidate inputs from delivery, professional services, compliance, operations, product, and security teams into a cohesive customer response.
* Support preparation of scope, deliverables, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and service acceptance criteria.
* Assist with pricing, effort estimation, resource assumptions, and commercial inputs in partnership with sales and delivery teams.
* Review customer requirements and identify risks, gaps, exclusions, or areas requiring clarification.
* Ensure that proposals and RFP responses are accurate, consistent, professionally written, and submitted on time.
* Maintain opportunity documentation, proposal trackers, content repositories, and internal approval records.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentation scripts, discovery questionnaires, and post-meeting follow-up communication.
* Track action items and coordinate timely closure with internal stakeholders.
* Maintain reusable content related to cybersecurity services, compliance offerings, customer use cases, methodologies, and frequently asked questions.
* Support sales enablement activities, customer workshops, webinars, industry events, and internal training sessions.
* Capture customer feedback and communicate recurring requirements, objections, and market observations to the relevant teams.
* Work closely with US-based sales colleagues during Eastern Time Zone working hours.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Approximately 5 years of professional experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in pre-sales, sales engineering, proposal management, bid management, solution support, or technology-services sales support.
* Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market customers in IT services, cybersecurity, compliance, risk, cloud, infrastructure, or managed services.
* Basic to moderate understanding of cybersecurity and risk and compliance concepts.
* Practical exposure to at least some of the following areas:
* Managed security services.
* Security monitoring.
* Vulnerability management.
* Penetration testing and security testing.
* Compliance assessments.
* Risk assessments.
* Security questionnaires.
* Governance, risk, and compliance services.
* Proven experience preparing RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, statements of work, and customer-facing documentation.
* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Strong ability to explain technical or service-related concepts in simple business language.
* Confidence in presenting to customers and facilitating structured discussions.
* Ability to work with incomplete information, ask relevant questions, and organize inputs from different stakeholders.
* Strong ownership of deadlines, follow-ups, documentation, and opportunity coordination.
* Good attention to detail and ability to review complex documents for accuracy and completeness.
* Ability to work effectively with US-based teams and customers.
* Comfortable working in US Eastern Time Zone-aligned hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, or similar standards and frameworks.
* Familiarity with common cybersecurity technologies, including SIEM, EDR, firewalls, endpoint security, cloud security, vulnerability management, and network security.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity, GRC, compliance, risk, or professional-services offerings.
* Experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security questionnaires.
* Experience working with international customers, particularly US customers.
* Exposure to CRM, CPQ, proposal management, ticketing, document management, or collaboration platforms.
* Certifications such as Security+, CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001, or similar are desirable but not mandatory.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, political affiliation or opinion, medical condition, status as a veteran, and/or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

* Create and refine PowerPoint presentations for client orals
* Experience working with SharePoint sites to manage proposal libraries, including case studies, standard RFP content, and active pursuits

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Hands‑on experience working on proposals and pursuits for the UK region
* Experience managing RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, proposal development, and bid timelines for SAP SuccessFactors programs (implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and optimization/AMS), covering modules such as Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning, Time Tracking, and Analytics
* Ability to create client‑facing collateral such as presentations, case studies, and proposal assets
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills
* Clear, concise business writing skills with the ability to consolidate SME inputs into client‑ready proposals
* Strong planning and execution skills with experience managing risks, issues, and deadlines
* Working knowledge of SuccessFactors delivery terminology and artifacts (module scope/configuration, business rules/workflows, role-based permissions, MDF objects, integrations, data migration, testing, change management, and AMS) to manage proposal content with SMEs

**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. Master's Degree

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.

* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.

3a1eae6c.title: Presales Manager
3a1eae6c.description:
Send your resumes at anmol.kak@aionos.ai

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Manager CX Pre-Sales & Solutions** to build and own our Pre-Sales & Solutions charter for CX operations, end-to-end. This is a senior, high-impact role reporting directly to the **VP & Head, CX Solutions, Transformation & Excellence**, responsible for solution design, bid strategy and governance, commercial/pricing ownership, and proposal development for new business pursuits and existing account expansions across all channels and business accounts.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Own solution design for new pursuits and account expansions, translating client requirements (RFP/RFI or direct ask) into an operating model covering staffing/FTE structure, technology stack, SLA construct, and transition approach.
* Partner with Operations, Training, Quality, IT, and Transition & PM teams to pressure-test feasibility of proposed solutions before submission.
* Build and maintain a reusable solution framework and playbook (staffing models, technology stack options, standard SLA constructs) to accelerate future pursuits.

  
  

**Bid Strategy, Governance & Commercial Ownership**

* Own go/no-go decisioning for inbound RFPs/RFIs, and end-to-end RFP/RFI lifecycle management, including intake, eligibility screening, compliance matrix creation, and timeline management.
* Coordinate inputs from cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Training, Quality) to ensure timely, complete responses.
* Build costing and pricing models for each pursuit, conduct competitive benchmarking and margin/profitability analysis, and partner with Finance for commercial approval and sign-off.
* Review contractual and commercial terms for risk flags, escalating to Legal/Finance as needed, and maintain a bid compliance tracker and audit trail.

  
  

**Proposal Development & Content Ownership**

* Own end-to-end proposal development, including content drafting, formatting, and final packaging, ensuring brand consistency and submission quality.
* Build and maintain the capability deck, case-study library, and boilerplate content bank for reuse across pursuits.
* Maintain version control and a submission archive for audit and reuse purposes.

  
  

**Stakeholder & Business Partnership**

* Partner with account leadership, Operations, Training, and Quality to align pursuit strategy with delivery capability.
* Represent Pre-Sales & Solutions in client-facing discovery calls, orals, and executive presentations.
* Present pipeline status, win/loss analysis, and pursuit health to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

  
  

**Function Build-Out & Team Leadership**

* Build the business case for, and hire into, the Pre-Sales & Solutions team (Bid & Commercial Manager, Bid Associate) as pursuit volume grows.
* Set the function's operating rhythm, including pursuit intake process, go/no-go criteria, review cadences, and quality gates.
* Lead and mentor the team once hired, building a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

**Must-Have:**

* 9-12 years of progressive experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions, Bid Management, or Commercial roles in a CX/BPO environment, including experience owning end-to-end solution design and bid strategy for large deals (500+ FTE). This is an individual contributor role requiring strong ownership and strategic thinking across the deal lifecycle.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience across the full pursuit lifecycle: solutioning, bid governance, commercial/pricing modeling, and proposal development, ideally in a lean or individual-contributor capacity before scaling a team.
* Strong commercial acumen with hands-on financial/pricing modeling skills.
* Excellent written communication and proposal-writing skills, with experience owning content and collateral libraries.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive presence, with experience presenting to senior/C-level audiences.

  
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the travel/airline or aviation-linked CX/BPO industry.
* Exposure to multi-geography or multi-site operating models (India and overseas).
* Bid/Proposal Management certification (APMP or equivalent).

  
  

**Position details:**

* **Location:** Gurgaon | Full-time, On-site
* **Working Days:** 5 Days a Week | 10 Hours Shift (flexibility to travel & work across sites)
* **Reporting To:** VP & Head CX Solutions, Transformation & Excellence

  
  

Send your resumes at **anmol.kak@aionos.ai**

About Sarvatva

Sarvatva is a multidisciplinary architecture, interiors, and engineering consultancy working across residential, commercial, and institutional projects. Our work covers the complete process from concept design and 3D visualization to technical documentation and site execution.

We are looking for a **Senior Architect** who can independently lead projects from design development through execution, manage client and consultant coordination, and guide junior architects and designers.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead and independently manage architectural projects** from concept to execution.
* Handle **residential and redevelopment projects**, ensuring design intent, quality and timely delivery.
* Develop and review **SD packages, working drawings, detailed drawings and GFC/execution drawings**.
* Lead **design development, planning, detailing and technical documentation**.
* Coordinate with **clients, structural/MEP consultants, contractors and site teams**.

* Review drawings and resolve **design, technical and site-related issues**.
* Lead and mentor **junior architects and designers**, allocating tasks and reviewing deliverables.
* Manage project timelines, deliverables and coordination across multiple stakeholders.
* Prepare and present **design proposals, 3D views, renderings and presentations** to clients.
* Participate in client meetings and confidently communicate **design decisions, project requirements and technical solutions**.

* **AutoCAD** – Advanced working knowledge
* **Photoshop** – Presentations & post-production
* **Lumion** – 3D visualization & rendering
* **Revit Architecture & BIM** – Working knowledge
* **PowerPoint** – Professional presentations

We’re Looking For

* **5–8 years of relevant architectural experience**
* Strong experience in **residential and redevelopment projects**
* Proven ability to **independently lead projects**
* Strong knowledge of **architectural detailing, construction and execution**
* Excellent **plan reading, working drawing and GFC drawing** skills
* Good understanding of **interior design, 3D modelling and visualization**
* Strong **client handling and consultant coordination** skills
* Ability to **lead, guide and review junior team members**
* Good understanding of **site execution and construction processes**
* Strong communication, coordination and problem-solving skills
* Willingness to undertake **regular site visits**
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects within deadlines

Role Expectations

The Senior Architect will be expected to take **ownership of assigned projects**, act as the key coordination point between the client, consultants and internal team, and ensure that the project moves efficiently from **design to successful execution**.

a50be904.title: Managed Services Consultant - Sr
a50be904.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot-to-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day-to-day support for post go-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

**What Makes You Qualified?**

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Who You Are**

  

* Detail-oriented and hands-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer-facing, fast-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day-to-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Volvo Group**

We are looking for a Solution Architect to join the Business Risk & Compliance and Legal Product Area within Group Digital. You are a strategic thinker and have a strong understanding of business processes and governance frameworks and can translate complex business requirements into simple, scalable, and integrated solutions. Your holistic mindset enables you to connect business needs, process design, data, and technology capabilities to deliver sustainable outcomes.

94ebe382.title: SFDC Architect
94ebe382.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

157bf7f5.title: Solution Architect, Public Sector India
157bf7f5.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.
  
  
**Purpose**
Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.
  
  
**India Public Sector Context**

* Who we serve: central ministries, state governments, PSUs, regulators, smart city and urban bodies, and digital public infrastructure programs.
* Where ServiceNow fits: citizen grievance and service delivery, case management, GRC, IT operations for large government estates, workflow over legacy systems, and AI-assisted operations.
* How deals happen: tender-led (RFP/RFQ, GeM), SI and partner-led bids, price-sensitive evaluation, long sales cycles.
* What shapes the design: data residency, MeitY-empanelled cloud, CERT-In and security audits, the DPDP Act, and Make in India preferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Public Sector BD & Sales Leads for the GTM plan for Central and State Ministries, Public Sector Banks and Higher Education / Universities
* Lead architecture sessions with government CIO, IT, and NIC teams, translating program goals into actionable blueprints.
* Own the technical response on RFPs and tenders: compliance matrices, architecture, sizing, and clarifications.
* Build and run proof of concepts and demos across AI, workflow, and integration that prove value in days, not weeks.
* Design within government constraints: hosting, data localisation, security, AI governance, and integration with legacy and national platforms.
* Co-sell with SIs and partners on solution scope, bid strategy, and delivery handoff.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Consultants, Specialists, Product, and Legal on deal strategy and risk.
* Work with regional AI experts to shape and validate AI solutions and proof of concepts.
* Build reusable India public sector assets: reference architectures, AI use-case patterns, an RFP response library, and a compliance FAQ.
* Mentor Solution Consultants on public sector sales motions.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8-10 years of exclusive public sector pre-sales experience (government, PSU, or SI/OEM on government programs).
* Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
* AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.
* Expertise in AI architecture, workflow automation, data & analytics, and integration frameworks
* Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.
* Depth in enterprise workflow or ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred; fast ramp expected if not), plus integration, API, data, and automation architecture.
* Trusted advisor on deal strategy, not only demos.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, NCR (New Delhi), with regular travel to government offices

**Good To Have**

* Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including Now Assist and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with MeitY empanelment, GeM, CERT-In, the DPDP Act, and the IndiaAI Mission.
* Existing government and SI network.

**What We Offer**

* A structured AI upskilling path to expert level over 6-12 months.
* Direct access to regional AI experts for design, proof of concepts, and deal support.
* Ground-floor ownership of a new vertical in India.

TR21
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

e7b0f120.title: Sr. Application Architect
e7b0f120.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.
