This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Global Sales**
at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Responsible for architecting solutions that will support Partners in achieving their customers' business outcomes across the HPE Private Cloud AI portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third-party components (e.g. ISV integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**

* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Translates outcome-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Participates in deep-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Produces in-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.
* Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up-selling, and cross-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.

**Education And Experience**
**What you need to bring:**

* First-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 8–12 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge-based as well as 1+ experienced-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.
* Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point-of-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line-of-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
* Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Advanced project and time management knowledge or experience with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
* Advanced knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go-to-market strategy.
* Advanced understanding of Geo application of company’s go-to-market strategy as it relates to partners; has broad knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals.

1b2f040f.title: Cybersecurity - Pre-sales (Commission Based)
1b2f040f.description:
**Company Description**
  
HackHalt Cyber Intelligence Council is a Section 8 organization committed to combating cybercrime worldwide and strengthening digital safety for individuals, businesses, and government bodies. The company focuses on AI-driven cybersecurity and advanced research to proactively identify, prevent, and respond to emerging threats. Its work is structured around four core pillars: Prevention, Education, Detection, and Rapid Response, offering a comprehensive approach to cyber risk management. Supported by more than 40 global partners and a track record of training over 10,000 individuals by 2026, HackHalt is building resilient cyber ecosystems and empowering the next-generation cyber workforce.
  
**Role Description**
  
This is a full-time, remote Cybersecurity Pre-sales (Commission Based) role focused on supporting the growth of HackHalt’s cybersecurity solutions and services. The individual in this position will engage prospective clients, understand their security challenges, and present tailored technical and business value propositions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting needs assessments, participating in discovery calls, preparing demos and presentations, and collaborating with technical teams to design solutions aligned with client requirements. The role also involves responding to RFPs/RFIs, creating proposal documents, supporting proof-of-concept engagements, and maintaining accurate records of opportunities and client interactions. The position is commission-based, requiring strong initiative, goal orientation, and the ability to build and maintain long-term professional relationships.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Cybersecurity and Information Security skills, with a solid understanding of common threats, controls, and risk management principles.
* Candidates should possess Network Security skills, including familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and secure network architectures.
* Candidates should possess Application Security skills, such as awareness of secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and common application-layer attack vectors.
* Candidates should possess broad Cyber domain knowledge, including current threat landscapes, industry compliance standards, and security frameworks.
* Relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales within the cybersecurity or IT domain is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value for diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple opportunities, and meet commission-based performance targets.
* Preferred qualifications include a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, and industry certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent.

a3882c9a.title: Delivery Lead
a3882c9a.description:
**Job Title: Delivery Lead**

The Senior Process Consultant / Delivery Lead is responsible for leading a Sub Value Stream portfolio / Global Programme and driving end-to-end process re-engineering and transformation initiatives to deliver agreed transformation objectives.

The purpose of the Operation Transformation Process Consultant is to support the end-to-end process re-engineering / transformation activities that will deliver transformation goals.

The role requires deep expertise in customer-centric, data-driven process improvement and transformation, covering 4Cs: Customer, Colleague, Cost, Control, and Scalability. The Delivery Lead drives strategic planning and supports Operating Models, governance, tooling, and delivery execution to ensure sustainable business outcomes.

The role also acts as a change catalyst, partnering with Global Business Lines across geographies (primarily home and priority markets) and supporting multiple internal engagements to drive measurable performance improvement.

**In this role, you will:**

* Operate at a Programme delivery level, working for global business and regions and helping the Operations Transformation, business transformation to focus on end customers.
* To deliver the Global Ops transformation programs delivering P&L targets by focusing on the globally directed projects and initiatives by identifying strategic opportunities, designing, implementing, and embedding the change to the operations processes.
* Responsible for leading transformation of different complexities focusing on end-to-end digital journeys with a lens on scalable and reusable solutions and leading other Delivery Leads & Senior Process consultant’s in managing a large transformation program to deliver an agreed set of business objectives.
* Facilitate program governance, RAID management, Fortnightly / Monthly governance packs for Accounts Business Services. Position ID validation with Finance, Anaplan Governance Oversight, Change Request (CRs) Management, JIRA Ticket Housekeeping, Forecast Confidence analysis with Operations Leads by providing a forward view.
* The role requires to oversee and mentor Delivery Leads and Senior process consultants in a program/project environment guiding them to deliver program/project objectives
* For specific functional areas, deliver step change in operational performance (cost, service levels, and customer satisfaction) through identification and successful initiation of new process improvement initiatives aligned with local/regional transformation goals.
* Act as a strategic transformation delivery lead focusing on operational excellence & working closing with stakeholders to identify key projects. Provide detail input to ensure commercially viable decisions are taken on prioritizing and optimizing the project portfolio.
* Work closely with different transformation programme and providing on ground support from DBS Operations transformation perspective with Revisit projects post deployment on regular basis to validate whether the objectives are met and sustainable
* Be knowledgeable of key business drivers – WFM data, process maps, process insights, data intelligence etc. Also Organize & lead process reviews, walkthrough, bootcamp sessions.
* Mobilize right support for reengineering projects and ensuring designs are translated into implementation- including Tech funding ask, Business case creation, supporting Jira work for demand intake process.
* Anticipate issues and risks and address them quickly, with an understanding of the critical path. Contemplate contingencies and develop strategies to manage risks and collaborate with other enablers & teams i.e. Automation, Technology, Operation Transformation Program Office to drive Global and local re-engineering initiatives

**Leadership & Teamwork:**

* Own value creation planning, ensuring benefits, scope, schedule, and costs are clearly defined, tracked, and realized.
* Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, customer experience, control effectiveness, and scalability.
* Use data-driven insights to assess performance, validate outcomes post-deployment, and drive continuous improvement.
* Balance speed, risk, and value to ensure sustainable delivery outcomes.

**Operational Performance:**

* Provide hands-on delivery oversight, ensuring projects meet milestones, quality standards, and financial commitments.
* Review and challenge delivery plans, resourcing models, and execution approaches to maximize effectiveness.
* Drive standardization through use of approved templates, tools, and delivery methodologies.
* Ensure post-implementation reviews are conducted and lessons learned are embedded into future delivery.

**People and Capability Development:**

* Identify capability gaps and work with Programme Directors to secure appropriate skills and resources.
* Set clear expectations, roles, and accountability for delivery team members.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance team environment.
* Act as a role model for delivery excellence

**To be successful you will:**

**Experience**

* 10 to 15 years of experience in operations transformation, operations strategy, programme delivery, and change management, ideally within financial services.
* Domain understanding of overall banking and financial/consulting services industry especially Private banking & Wealth knowledge will be preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi-country and multi-stakeholder programmes.
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.
* Experience working across global operating models and matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success in delivering measurable business outcomes across cost, efficiency, customer experience, and control.
* Be a strong team player and contribute to the success of teamwork, taking up different roles and activities.
* Track-record of leading Agile multi-disciplined teams to deliver exceptional customer service and value.
* Preferably Black Belt trained / certified, Agile coach & scrum master certification
* Strong problem-solving skills using end to end process reviews and data driven analysis.
* Exposure / experience to Microsoft Power Platform, AI and other automations tools / techniques will be an added

c70b459b.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
c70b459b.description:
**About Refold**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the technical win:**
  Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* **Build the proof, don't slide it:**
  Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* **Run crisp POCs:**
  Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* **Speak both languages:**
  Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* **Clear security and procurement:**
  Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* **Hand off clean:**
  Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* **Feed the platform:**
  You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* **Build the SE motion:**
  Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information:**

* **Partners with:**
  The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* **Average deal size:**
  $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Average deal cycle:**
  3–6 months
* **Technical buyers you'll face:**
  CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* **Ideal customer:**
  Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Competitive set:**
  iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* **Current growth team:**
  1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Proven SE:**
  5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* **Builder, not just a presenter:**
  Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* **Enterprise systems fluency:**
  Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* **Sales instinct:**
  You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* **Room-ready:**
  You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* **High ownership in ambiguity:**
  No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

**Nice to Have**

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

9c0e4a71.title: Lead Solution Architect - ADMS Presales | Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization
9c0e4a71.description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Bangalore
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12807
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/13/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  
**Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization**
**Role family:**
Business Consulting / Solution Architecture
  
  
**Technology focus:**
Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.

Leadership and Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.
* Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs.
* Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning.
* Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation.
* Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable.

**Technology and Platform Exposure**
**Front end and mobile:**
Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility.
  
  
**Back end and APIs:**
Spring Boot, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management.

Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance.

API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security.

0aec81cd.title: Technology Architect
0aec81cd.description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP BTP Application Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), Node.js  
Minimum **18** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.  
SAP BTP Development Manager  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.  
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and delivery ownership.  
Preferred Qualifications  
SAP certification in BTP application development, integration, data, analytics, AI engineering, or a related specialization.  
Experience with SAP Joule Studio and the design or orchestration of AI agents.  
Experience with SAP Document AI, SAP Build Process Automation, Event Mesh, and asynchronous architectures.  
Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud Predictive Analysis Library, Automated Predictive Library, and vector capabilities.  
Experience integrating models and services from Hyperscaler or SAP AI ecosystem partners through governed enterprise patterns.  
Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated environments with privacy, security, data residency, and compliance obligations.  
Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks, model risk management, evaluation benchmarks, red teaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Experience creating reusable assets, engineering playbooks, and communities of practice for enterprise AI adoption.  
Leadership Competencies  
Strategic orientation: Connect AI investments to business outcomes, adoption, and value realization.  
Technical judgment: Make pragmatic build, buy, reuse, and integration decisions across SAP and partner services.  
Delivery leadership: Manage scope, quality, schedule, cost, dependencies, and operational readiness across concurrent workstreams.  
Talent development: Build high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability development.  
Executive communication: Explain complex AI concepts, design trade-offs, risks, and value in clear business language.  
Collaboration and ownership: Work effectively across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, legal, risk, and operations teams.  
Measures of Success  
AI use cases delivered on time, within agreed quality and risk thresholds, and with measurable business outcomes.  
Production reliability, security, performance, adoption, and responsible-AI compliance of deployed solutions.  
Reuse of approved architecture patterns, accelerators, components, and engineering standards.  
Improvement in engineering productivity, automated test coverage, release quality, and time to value.  
Stakeholder satisfaction and growth in the capability, proficiency, and retention of the engineering team.  
  
Additional Information:
  
Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related discipline.  
Typically 10+ years of enterprise application or technology delivery experience, including 3+ years leading SAP BTP, AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering teams.

  
15 years full time education

af7216e9.title: AI Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
af7216e9.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience working within tech startups or digital-native organizations.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing financial services or telecommunication agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, Cloud infrastructure, Agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
Leading with the future, the AI GTM team are trusted AI advisors, expanding across Google to deliver transformative customer experiences that shape the next generation of their business. Partnering to provide AI expertise, thought leadership, and industry best practices, we revolutionize customer outcomes.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building customer relationships.
* Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-to-Market team. Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

98ef7e80.title: AI CX Solutions Consultant -  5+yrs - AI tools, Python/Node.js
98ef7e80.description:
**About The Team**
Cisco Webex Customer Experience is building Connected Intelligence: an operating model that brings customer interactions, human and AI agents, workflows, and enterprise systems together. It is organised around four pillars: an intelligent front door, context-driven orchestration, an extensible AI-native platform, and trust and security by design.
  
  
As an AI Solutions Consultant, you will help make this approach real through working demonstrations, customer prototypes, integrations, and repeatable use cases. You will work alongside AI Solution Consultants, Forward Deployed Engineers, account teams, partners, product managers, and engineering teams.
  
  
You will translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions using APIs, webhooks, enterprise systems, AI Agent Studio, and modern AI application-development practices. You will help move ideas from concept to validated use case, while building the technical depth required to support production deployments over time.
  
  
You will deliver three outcomes from each engagement: a working solution, evidence that the use case creates customer value, and a reusable implementation pattern.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate customer use cases and solution designs into technical build plans and working prototypes.
* Build integrations using Python, Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and enterprise platforms.
* Configure and develop conversational AI and workflow experiences using Webex AI capabilities and Webex AI Agent Studio.
* Connect AI experiences to Salesforce, ServiceNow, CRM platforms, contact-centre systems, knowledge sources, and enterprise APIs.
* Develop use cases involving AI agents, voice experiences, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and real-time analytics where appropriate.
* Create customer demonstrations, technical prototypes, pilots, and proof-of-concept solutions.
* Map data flows, system dependencies, events, actions, error conditions, and human hand-offs.
* Apply practical controls for security, privacy, access, observability, testing, and operational reliability.
* Test integrations and AI experiences for accuracy, latency, resilience, usability, and appropriate escalation.
* Instrument solutions so customer and internal teams can measure usage, quality, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Troubleshoot integration, configuration, data, and AI behaviour issues with support from senior engineers and product teams.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions, technical workshops, design reviews, and pilot readouts.
* Work with AI Solution Consultants and FDEs to refine requirements and prepare solutions for production deployment.
* Capture product gaps and implementation lessons with clear technical detail and customer impact.
* Document reusable integrations, configuration patterns, use cases, demonstrations, and troubleshooting methods.
* Contribute to internal enablement, solution libraries, reference architectures, and pre-built assets.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience building software, integrations, automation, or enterprise technology solutions; demonstrated technical ability may substitute for tenure.
* Hands-on experience with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or a comparable programming language.
* Experience working with APIs, webhooks, authentication, data transformation, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with Git, debugging, testing, logging, and basic software-development practices.
* Familiarity with at least one major LLM ecosystem or AI application-development framework.
* Understanding of conversational AI, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, or workflow automation.
* Ability to read technical documentation and learn unfamiliar platforms quickly.
* Experience working with customers, internal stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel approximately 15 to 25 percent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, contact-centre operations, or customer-experience technology.
* Experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, IVR platforms, call-routing systems, knowledge bases, or enterprise data platforms.
* Familiarity with Cisco Webex Customer Experience products and services.
* Experience building conversational or voice-agent prototypes.
* Experience with cloud platforms, event-driven integrations, OAuth, queues, or serverless workflows.
* Familiarity with observability, automated testing, security controls, and production-readiness practices.
* Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, demonstrations, or reusable code assets.

Skills and Attributes
  
  

* Builder mindset with a bias towards creating working software.
* Able to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear technical next step.
* Comfortable learning by doing and working across unfamiliar systems.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Understands the difference between a convincing demo and a dependable solution.
* Takes ownership while knowing when to involve senior engineers, FDEs, or product teams.
* Communicates technical issues clearly and directly.
* Pays attention to detail across data, configuration, testing, and user experience.
* Interested in both the customer problem and the technical implementation.
* Collaborative, curious, pragmatic, and committed to continuous learning.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

**Description**

Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
This job opening is for a Senior Leader, Solution Architecture role focused on building solutions for customers around AWS platform services and industry solutions. It sits within the Public Sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited.
  
  
We work with central government ministries, state and local governments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), education institutions, EdTech startups (including India-based unicorns), non-profits, and healthcare organizations. Our vision is to be part of India's growth journey helping institutions make a significant impact on the lives of citizens by taking a technology-generation leap through AWS cloud services.
  
  
In this role, you will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right. You will partner with business leaders to lead thought-leadership conversations with customers on AWS services and platforms. You will interact, communicate, and partner across AWS including service teams, marketing, and business development and represent AWS to executive management.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work with business leaders and fellow Solutions Architects to convey cloud computing best practices and build reference architectures across compute, storage, enterprise applications, developer technologies, and industry solutions.
* Develop strategy with Specialist Solutions Architects to enable the wider AWS business to succeed.
* Partner with Professional Services, service teams, and AWS Support to drive customer success.
* Plan, review, and author technical content (such as white papers and reference architectures) that customers can use to deploy secure, cloud-based solutions.
* Facilitate knowledge assessment across AWS business development and Solutions Architecture teams, and develop plans to address gaps.
* Work with industry groups to influence trends in cloud computing.
* Represent AWS at conferences, events, and meetups.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
* Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
* Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
* Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

6582e0bc.title: Senior Forward Deployed Architect, Generative AI
6582e0bc.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
NVIDIA is looking for a Forward Deployed Architect to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance across AI Accelerator engagements with AI Native organizations, NeoCloud Providers, and ISVs. You'll advise on architecture and integration, define what good looks like, and bring learnings back to inform the DSX product roadmap. This role is engaged when standard product capabilities are not enough and the work needs to be specialized. Curious about novel hardware before it has a playbook? Excited to define how new platforms get used at scale? Our team works alongside customers and partners on infrastructure problems no one has solved yet, helping teams adopt NVIDIA technology the right way and shaping how new AI workloads get deployed.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Cross-Account Technical Leadership. Provide architectural direction across strategic engagements where standard capabilities are not enough and advanced implementation, optimization, or integration customization is needed.
* Outcome-Focused Implementation. Help customers integrate the right components to deliver on their outcomes. Where DSX software fits, advise on adopting it the right way. Where it doesn't, help them succeed with the right alternative and bring the gap back to product and engineering.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership. Dive into complex technical challenges hands-on when needed to solve critical problems, validate architectures, or prove out solutions.
* Strategic Initiative Ownership. Lead technically demanding programs end to end, including third-party performance benchmarking across hardware and workloads.
* Pattern Identification and Knowledge Sharing. Identify common challenges and solution patterns across engagements. Share findings with internal teams and the broader AI community.
* Technical Standardization. Develop standardized approaches, reference architectures, and structured guidance rooted in patterns from successful engagements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with product, engineering, and other customer-facing NVIDIA teams so what we learn in the field informs internal strategy and capabilities.
* Strategic Architecture. Design technical strategies for advanced AI workloads (distributed training, large-scale inference, model and pipeline optimization, MLOps) that apply across multiple customers and partners.
* New Hardware Enablement. Help develop new infrastructure patterns and playbooks for the latest NVIDIA hardware as it lands with customers and partners.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technical roles such as solutions architecture, ML engineering, technical product management, or technical consulting across multiple customers or projects. Alternatively, 5+ years of specialist-level experience working at the frontier of AI infrastructure.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Systems thinking with the ability to understand customer outcomes and translate them into clear technical requirements and architectures.
* Willingness to prototype, implement, validate, and troubleshoot hands-on when needed to solve critical problems or prove out approaches.
* A solid technical foundation in the technologies AI infrastructure is built on, especially Linux systems administration.
* A self-directed learner who can ramp on brand new technologies and unfamiliar technical domains independently.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and multi-functional collaborators.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Solutions architecture or technical consulting background across multiple customer engagements simultaneously, with experience bringing novel AI hardware or frameworks to production with frontier AI Native organizations, hyperscalers, NeoClouds, or ISVs.
* A foundational cloud or distributed systems background built at hyperscaler scale.
* A public technical voice: blog posts, talks, open-source contributions, or reference work that shows depth and opinion.
* Hands-On Technical Expertise in one or more of: NVIDIA Stack (CUDA, NeMo, Triton, TensorRT, NIM, DGX Cloud, and the broader DSX software portfolio), Inference Systems (large-scale inference with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang, prefill-decode disaggregation, performance optimization across hardware), Training Systems (distributed training, model and pipeline optimization, open-source generative AI frameworks), Infrastructure (SLURM, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, distributed computing frameworks, rack-scale systems, multiple CSP or NCP cloud environments), and Observability and Automation (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GPU performance monitoring).

3dfd2ba8.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
3dfd2ba8.description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

eb3e0036.title: Solution Architect, Salesforce Customer Experience
eb3e0036.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
  
  
The DCTx brings together digital journey, platform, and delivery capabilities to create connected and scalable customer and dealer experiences across AGCO.  The CX Journey Team owns the end-to-end customer experience and outcomes, translating customer, dealer and business needs into journeys, priorities and measurable CX requirements. It works upstream with business, brands, regions, customers and dealers, and downstream with other Journey, Platform, Data and Technology teams that provide the capabilities and execution needed to deliver those experiences at scale. The Sr Solution Architect, Customer Experience owns the design and end-to-end architecture for the customer experience solutions covering architecture & solution designs, APIs, data models, NFRs and tech enablers that support customer listening, onboarding, ownership readiness, and AI-enabled engagement across AGCO's ownership journey. He partners with business and platform teams to define scalable, integrated, and reusable and globally aligned agentic capabilities that improve customer experience.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Lead solution architecture for major initiatives, platforms, applications, integrations and data flows, translating business and technical requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable designs.
* Define and govern architecture standards and documentation, including solution designs, architecture diagrams, decision records, integration patterns, APIs and implementation guidance, aligned with security, data, privacy and enterprise architecture principles.
* Evaluate solution options and guide delivery teams, balancing business value, feasibility, cost, risk, scalability, performance, resilience and maintainability throughout design, build, test and deployment.
* Drive technical improvement and modernization, identifying dependencies and risks, promoting reusable patterns and platform capabilities, and contributing to cloud adoption, architecture roadmaps, technical debt reduction and operational stability.
* Evaluate AI and automation opportunities, including generative AI and AI-enabled solutions, considering business value, data readiness, integration, responsible AI, security, privacy and governance while staying current with emerging AI and technology trends.

**Your Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Business Informatics, Data, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. Typically, 6–8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in architecture, solution design, software engineering, enterprise applications, integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms, data, cybersecurity, or digital platforms. Typically, 6–8 years of relevant software development experience, including complex enterprise applications, digital platforms, integrations, cloud, data, or IT delivery.
* Deep architecture and system design expertise across enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, cloud, data flows, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity, and operational models.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills, able to independently solve complex architecture challenges, evaluate alternatives, and lead architecture deliverables and workstreams.
* Practical AI expertise, including generative AI, AI agents, automation opportunities, data readiness, responsible AI, governance, privacy, security, and business-use-case evaluation. Security-by-design and business-oriented mindset, ensuring solutions address security, compliance, resilience, user needs, operational sustainability, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong communication and technical leadership, including architecture documentation, stakeholder influence, cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across emerging technologies and AI.

**Your Benefits**

* GLOBAL DIVERSITY – Diversity means many things to us, different brands, cultures, nationalities, genders, generations – even variety in our roles. You make us unique!
* ENTERPRISING SPIRIT- Every role adds value. We are committed to helping you develop and grow to realize your potential.
* POSITIVE IMPACT – Make it personal and help us feed the world.
* INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES - You can combine your love for technology with manufacturing excellence – and work alongside teams of people worldwide who share your enthusiasm.
* MAKE THE MOST OF YOU – Benefits include health care and wellness plans and flexible and virtual work options.

**Your Workplace**
We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.
  
  
**Join us as we bring agriculture into the future and apply now!**
Please note that this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all required activities, duties, responsibilities, or benefits and may change at any time with or without notice.

9236e4e8.title: Sr. Application Architect
9236e4e8.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
