e4bbed04.title: Lead, Enterprise Architect
e4bbed04.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Lead, Solution Architect**
Your Role
  
  
We are seeking a technically hands-on Solution Architect who combines strong architecture expertise with practical engineering capability, to help deliver solutions in the Enterprise Architecture team. This individual will operate as a player-coach, contributing directly to solution design and implementation - writing code, building automations, and enhancing AI-driven solutions.
  
  
This role is ideal for an architect who does not want to stay purely at the conceptual level, but instead actively participates supports in building, prototyping, and evolving enterprise solutions alongside engineering teams.
  
  
**Requirements/Job Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture and Engineering Execution Design
* Develop solution designs for enterprise architecture solutions and consult with other teams as needed Design enterprise architecture solutions, consulting with other teams as needed.
* Develop Proofs-of-Concept to validate architectural decisions
* Develop proofs-of-concept and reference implementations to validate architectural decisions
* Propose changes to Design and evolve enterprise architecture patterns across cloud, SaaS, and AI-enabled platforms
* Directly contribute to codebases where appropriate (e.g., APIs, automation, integrations, AI agents)
* Develop proofs-of-concept and reference implementations to validate architectural decisions
* Develop solution designs for enterprise architecture solutions and consult with other teams as needed
* AI and Automation Development
* Design, build, and enhance AI agents and copilots using modern frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, LangChain, Semantic Kernel)
* Contribute to prompt engineering, orchestration logic, and integration patterns
* Automate enterprise governance and operational processes using tools such as Power Automate, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or similar
* Platform & Integration Engineering
* Write and review code for APIs, microservices, and integration layers
* Build reusable services and automation pipelines that accelerate delivery teams
* Assist in debugging, performance tuning, and resolving complex technical issues
* Governance & Standards
* Define and Support the definition and enforcement of e architecture standards while ensuring they are practical and implementable
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure alignment between architecture and delivery
* Support modern engineering practices (CI/CD, IaC, testing strategies) into enterprise workflows
* Collaboration & Leadership
* Act as a bridge between architecture and engineering teams
* Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to developers and solution architects
* Engage with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs
* Programming & Development
* Proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
* Experience building APIs, services, and automation workflows
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices
* Cloud & Platforms
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Experience building and deploying cloud-native applications (containers, serverless, microservices)
* AI & Emerging Technology
* Practical experience building or integrating AI/ML or LLM-based solutions
* Understanding of agent-based architectures, prompt orchestration, and AI governance
* Ability to evaluate and apply emerging technologies in real-world enterprise contexts

**Preferred Skills**

* AI System & Agentic Workflows
* Design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, Haystack Agents, ReAct-style agents).
* Implement multi-agent collaboration patterns, task orchestration, memory architectures, tool integrations, and reasoning-enhancing strategies.
* Develop secure, robust, and scalable tool‑calling and function-execution flows for agents operating in dynamic environments.
* Automation & Integration
* Experience with workflow automation tools (Power Automate, Logic Apps, etc.)
* Strong understanding of system integration patterns (REST, messaging, event-driven architecture)
* Enterprise Architecture
* Knowledge of architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) with a pragmatic, execution-focused mindset
* Experience defining Application of architecture patterns, standards, and reusable design components

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, patterns, and best practices, with familiarity in cloud computing and SaaS models.
* Excellent consultative and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with business, partner, and IT stakeholders.
* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Architect, or TOGAF a plus
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and risk frameworks (e.g., NIST, FFIEC, GDPR)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

bad16ece.description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned **AWS Architect** to lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale cloud solutions. This role demands deep technical expertise across AWS services, modern application architectures, and integration frameworks, with a focus on scalability, resilience, and security. The architect will partner with leadership, engineering, and business stakeholders to define cloud strategy and deliver mission-critical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Agent Plane**

* Architect solutions leveraging **Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore runtimes, Gateway/MCP**, and **Cedar policy**.
* Implement **guardrails and memory frameworks** for agent-based workloads.
* Establish governance models for GenAI-enabled applications.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**

* Design **knowledge bases** and deploy **OpenSearch Serverless**.
* Implement **entitlement-filtered retrieval** for secure and context-aware GenAI applications.
* Integrate vector search and retrieval pipelines with enterprise data lakes.

**Application & Compute Tier**

* Deploy applications using **Next.js on ECS Fargate**.
* Design **multi-AZ, autoscaling, and ALB-based architectures** for high availability.
* Optimize containerized workloads with **Docker/EKS** and serverless compute.

**Edge & Network**

* Architect secure **VPC subnet designs**, **PrivateLink endpoints**, and **NAT/egress allowlisting**.
* Configure **CloudFront** for content delivery and **WAF** for application security.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise networking standards.

**Identity**

* Implement **Cognito, Entra ID, OIDC/JWT, and JWKS verification** for authentication and authorization.
* Design federated identity solutions for multi-tenant environments.

**Security Services**

* Architect solutions with **Secrets Manager, KMS key design, GuardDuty, Security Hub**, and **least-privilege IAM**.
* Conduct architecture reviews, penetration testing, and compliance assessments.
* Establish proactive monitoring and incident response frameworks.

**Integration**

* Enable seamless connectivity with **Salesforce REST, ServiceNow Table API, Microsoft Graph**, and **MCP brokers (e.g., Workato)**.
* Design integration patterns for SaaS, on-prem, and hybrid systems.

**Operational Database**

* Architect **Aurora PostgreSQL Multi-AZ** deployments for resilience and scalability.
* Optimize database performance, replication, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Integrate with RDS, DynamoDB, and legacy systems where required.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of IT experience, with 5+ years in AWS architecture.
* Proven expertise in:

+ **Compute:** ECS Fargate, EKS, Lambda, Docker.
+ **Networking:** VPC, NAT, PrivateLink, CloudFront, WAF.
+ **Security:** IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub.
+ **Identity:** Cognito, OIDC/JWT, Entra ID.
+ **Databases:** Aurora PostgreSQL, RDS, DynamoDB.
+ **Integration:** Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph APIs.

* Hands-on experience with **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)** and vector search.
* Familiarity with **agent frameworks** (Bedrock, AgentCore).
* Strong background in Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform, CloudFormation**).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional.
* Experience with **GenAI workloads** and retrieval-augmented architectures.
* Exposure to hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Background in regulated industries (finance, legal, healthcare).

**Why Join Us**

* Lead cutting-edge AWS and GenAI initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership on enterprise cloud strategy.
* Drive innovation in secure, scalable, and modern architectures.
* High visibility role with direct impact on enterprise transformation.**Role & responsibilities**

b70c0d83.title: Cloud Engineers - AWS / Azure / GCP
b70c0d83.description:
**We're Hiring: Cloud Engineers AWS | Azure | GCP**

  

**(Multiple Openings | 4 - 10 Years Experience | Multiple Levels)**

**Location:** Pune / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Gurugram / Chandigarh / Chennai

*Specific location and work model may vary by position and role.*

**Industry:** Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)  
**Employment Type:** Permanent | Contract

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for experienced **Cloud Engineers specializing in AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** to design, implement, manage, and optimize scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.

  

The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure provisioning, networking, security, automation, monitoring, and cloud operations. Candidates should be capable of managing cloud environments, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, optimizing performance and costs, and supporting enterprise-scale cloud transformation initiatives.

  

**Open Positions & Designations**

**AWS Cloud Engineering**

* **AWS Cloud Engineer** (4 - 6 Years)
* **Senior AWS Cloud Engineer** (6 8 Years)
* **Lead AWS Cloud Engineer** (8 10 Years)
* **AWS Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist** (8 – 10 Years)

  

**Microsoft Azure Cloud Engineering**

* **Azure Cloud Engineer** (4 – 6 Years)
* **Senior Azure Cloud Engineer** (6 – 8 Years)
* **Lead Azure Cloud Engineer** (8 – 10 Years)
* **Azure Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist** (8 – 10 Years)

  

**Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineering**

* **GCP Cloud Engineer** (4 – 6 Years)
* **Senior GCP Cloud Engineer** (6 – 8 Years)
* **Lead GCP Cloud Engineer** (8 – 10 Years)
* **GCP Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist** (8 – 10 Years)

  

**1. AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)**

* Provision, configure, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Work with EC2, S3, EBS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ELB, and Auto Scaling.
* Configure cloud networking, subnets, route tables, security groups, and network access controls.
* Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.
* Monitor cloud resources using Amazon CloudWatch and configure alerts.
* Manage backups, snapshots, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Implement IAM roles, policies, encryption, and security best practices.
* Support application deployment, cloud migration, and operational activities.

  

**Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)**

* Design and implement scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS environments.
* Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Configure advanced networking, including Transit Gateway, VPC peering, VPN, and Direct Connect.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
* Optimize cloud performance, availability, resource utilization, and costs.
* Implement disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
* Work with ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud-native services as required.
* Establish monitoring, logging, security controls, and operational best practices.
* Mentor junior engineers and conduct technical reviews.

  

**Lead AWS Cloud Engineer / Architect ( 8 – 10 Years)**

* Architect enterprise-scale AWS cloud environments and landing zones.
* Define cloud architecture standards, governance policies, and deployment patterns.
* Lead cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
* Design multi-account strategies, hybrid cloud connectivity, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Drive security, compliance, resilience, and FinOps initiatives.
* Establish automation frameworks and standardized IaC practices.
* Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and cloud engineering teams.
* Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams.

  

**AWS Skills & Tools**

* **Core Services:** EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda
* **Networking:** VPC, Route 53, ELB/ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect
* **Security:** IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Security Groups, AWS Organizations
* **Containers:** Docker, ECS, EKS, ECR
* **IaC & Automation:** Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, Bash
* **Monitoring:** CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config
* **DevOps:** Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline
* **Additional Services:** SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Systems Manager, AWS Backup

  

**2. Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)**

* Provision, configure, and manage Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
* Work with Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, and Virtual Networks.
* Configure subnets, NSGs, route tables, VPN Gateway, and network connectivity.
* Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and access policies.
* Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
* Monitor resources using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerts.
* Support backup, recovery, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Assist with application deployment, cloud migration, and operational support.

  

**Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)**

* Design scalable, resilient, and secure Azure cloud environments.
* Implement enterprise networking using VNet peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Azure Firewall.
* Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform or Bicep.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
* Configure Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Functions, and container services.
* Implement monitoring, logging, security policies, and compliance controls.
* Optimize resource utilization, performance, availability, and cloud expenditure.
* Design backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to cloud architecture decisions.

  

**Lead Azure Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)**

* Architect enterprise-grade Azure environments, landing zones, and subscription structures.
* Define cloud governance, security baselines, resource organization, and policy standards.
* Lead Azure migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud initiatives.
* Design identity, network, security, and connectivity architectures.
* Establish automation frameworks, reusable IaC modules, and deployment standards.
* Drive cost optimization, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical planning, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, DevOps, and application teams.

  

**Azure Skills & Tools**

* **Core Services:** Azure VMs, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Azure Files
* **Networking:** VNet, NSG, Azure Firewall, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
* **Identity & Security:** Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud
* **Containers:** AKS, Azure Container Registry, Docker
* **IaC & Automation:** Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure CLI
* **Monitoring:** Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
* **DevOps:** Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* **Additional Services:** Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Backup, Site Recovery

  

**3. GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)**

**Key Responsibilities**

**GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)**

* Provision, configure, and manage Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
* Work with Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Configure VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules, routes, and Cloud NAT.
* Manage IAM roles, service accounts, and access permissions.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Google Cloud deployment tools.
* Monitor cloud resources using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
* Support backups, recovery, patching, and cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Assist with application deployment, migration, and cloud operations.

  

**Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)**

* Design scalable, highly available, and secure GCP environments.
* Implement advanced networking, including Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.
* Build reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform.
* Deploy and manage workloads using GKE, Cloud Run, and Compute Engine.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
* Configure centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Optimize cloud performance, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* Support security, compliance, and cloud governance initiatives.
* Mentor junior engineers and review technical implementations.

  

**Lead GCP Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)**

* Architect enterprise-scale GCP infrastructure and cloud landing zones.
* Define organization structures, folder hierarchies, project strategies, and governance controls.
* Lead cloud migration, modernization, and hybrid connectivity initiatives.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Establish reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
* Drive cost optimization, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Lead technical architecture reviews and provide guidance to cloud engineering teams.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application development, security, and DevOps teams.

  

**GCP Skills & Tools**

* **Core Services:** Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore
* **Networking:** VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud DNS
* **Identity & Security:** Cloud IAM, Service Accounts, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Organization Policy
* **Containers:** GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Docker
* **IaC & Automation:** Terraform, Google Cloud CLI, Ansible, Python, Bash
* **Monitoring:** Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Cloud Audit Logs
* **DevOps:** Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
* **Additional Services:** Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Backup and DR services

  

**Common Skills Across All Cloud Platforms**

* **Operating Systems:** Linux, Windows Server
* **Cloud Fundamentals:** Virtualization, networking, compute, storage, identity, and access management
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform and platform-native provisioning tools
* **Scripting:** Python, Bash, PowerShell
* **Networking:** DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancing
* **DevOps:** Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Monitoring & Operations:** Logging, alerting, incident management, root cause analysis
* **Security:** Least-privilege access, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance
* **ITSM:** Incident, change, problem, and service request management
* **Documentation:** Architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and technical documentation

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **4 – 10 years of professional experience** in cloud infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, or cloud architecture.
* Strong hands-on expertise in at least one primary cloud platform: **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP**.
* Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining secure and scalable cloud environments.
* Proficiency in cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or platform-native tools.
* Understanding of CI/CD, automation, containerization, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Relevant cloud certifications are preferred.
* Experience with enterprise environments, cloud migration, hybrid cloud, and distributed systems is an advantage.

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* **AWS:** AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
* **Azure:** Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* **GCP:** Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

**Job Description:**

**Job Title: Senior Technical Project Manager – HSE Technology**

**Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM)**

We are seeking a self-motivated Technical Project Manager to lead the implementation of Intelex, a global Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) management platform. This role will manage cross-functional stakeholders, implementation partners, technical resources, and business teams to deliver the solution on time, within budget, and within the approved scope.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing enterprise software implementations, system integrations, data migration, testing, change management, and post-go-live support. Experience with EHS, compliance, incident management, training, or operational platforms is preferred.

**Here is a glimpse of what you’ll do:**

* Lead the full EHS implementation lifecycle, from planning and design through configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and transition to operations.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Serve as the primary point of coordination among HSE, IT, HR, Operations, Security, Legal, Procurement, and external implementation partners.
* Develop and maintain the detailed project plan, implementation roadmap, governance model, and communication plan.
* Coordinate requirements gathering, process mapping, solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, training, and deployment activities.
* Lead integration planning with systems such as Workday, Arena, Salesforce, SSO, Box, SharePoint, and Okta.
* Oversee data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and archival requirements.
* Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, security reviews, and production readiness activities.
* Partner with HSE leaders and subject matter experts to standardize global processes for incident management, observations, inspections, corrective actions, training, permits, contractor management, compliance, and reporting.
* Lead implementation partners, vendors, developers, technical resources, and internal teams to ensure accountability and timely delivery.
* Establish and manage project governance, including status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, risk and issue registers, and steering committee updates.
* Provide regular reporting to executives and business stakeholders on progress, milestones, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and required decisions.
* Escalate delays, scope changes, budget concerns, and resource constraints, and recommend corrective action plans.
* Lead change management, communications, training, and user adoption activities to support a successful global rollout.
* Coordinate the transition to operational support, including knowledge transfer, support processes, documentation, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Ensure the implementation follows internal policies, security requirements, vendor governance standards, and project management best practices.

**Here is some of what you’ll need:**

* 7+ years of experience managing enterprise software implementations, technology projects, or technical programs.
* Experience leading SaaS, EHS, compliance, HR, ERP, or other enterprise platform implementations.
* Experience managing third-party implementation partners and software vendors.
* Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, data migration, testing, release management, and production deployment.
* Experience managing projects across multiple regions, business functions, and time zones.
* Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies.
* Proficiency with Jira, Microsoft Project or equivalent project management tools, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Visio, PowerPoint, Excel, and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of change management, digital adoption, user training, and organizational readiness.
* Excellent organizational, collaboration, facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business users, vendors, and executive leadership.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to operate strategically and manage multiple priorities.
* Experience developing executive presentations, status reports, dashboards, and project documentation.
* Ability to identify risks early, drive decisions, resolve issues, and hold project team members accountable.

**Differentiating Factors**

* Experience implementing Intelex or another EHS management platform.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering teams, platforms, and stakeholder organizations.

Establish clear program plans, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.

Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams.

execution discipline.

Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies.

2c5fa5b8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
2c5fa5b8.description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead complex, cross-team engineering programs built on Java. You will be an enabler for the engineering teams who own delivery — bringing structure, visibility and alignment from scoping through launch — while engaging deeply with engineers on architecture, dependencies and technical trade-offs.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of engineering and execution. You will be the person who turns ambiguous goals into a clear plan, keeps multiple teams moving in step, and gives leadership an honest, early view of risk.
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program enablement**

* Enable large, multi-quarter programs spanning several engineering teams, partnering with the engineering managers who own delivery from charter through launch and post-launch review.
* Build integrated program plans with milestones, critical path, dependencies and resourcing; keep them current as reality changes.
* Facilitate the program operating rhythm: planning, standups or syncs, status reporting, release readiness and retrospectives.
* Coach teams on Agile (Scrum/Kanban) practices and help adapt the delivery model to fit team size, risk and deadlines.

**Technical partnership**

* Engage with engineers on system design, Java/JVM service architecture, APIs and integration points well enough to challenge estimates and spot hidden dependencies.
* Partner with architects and tech leads on technical debt, scalability, performance and migration plans, and make the trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* Review design documents and help translate technical constraints into scope, timeline and risk decisions.
* Work with DevOps and QA on CI/CD, release management, environments and quality gates.

**Risk, governance and communication**

* Identify risks and blockers early, maintain a RAID log, and help owners drive mitigation, escalating when needed.
* Communicate program status, decisions and trade-offs clearly to engineering leaders, product, and senior executives.
* Define and track delivery metrics such as predictability, velocity, defect trends and milestone health.
* Facilitate scope-change decisions, track budgets, and keep cross-functional partners (Product, Security, Compliance, Operations) aligned.

**Process and people**

* Improve engineering and program management practices across the organization.
* Mentor junior TPMs
* Coordinate with vendors where programs depend on them.

**Experience**
**Required qualifications**

* 10+ years in software delivery, with at least 5 years as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager or equivalent.
* A track record of enabling large programs involving 3+ engineering teams and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical depth (Java)**

* Strong working knowledge of Java-based systems — core Java concepts, Spring / Spring Boot and the JVM — enough to engage credibly with engineers; hands-on coding is not required.
* Solid understanding of microservices, REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Able to review design documents, follow technical debates, and ask the questions that surface real risk.

**Project and program management**

* Deep command of the full project lifecycle: initiation, planning, estimation, scheduling, execution, monitoring and closure.
* Strong practice in Agile and hybrid delivery, including sprint planning, release planning and dependency management at scale.
* Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, diagramming tool such as Lucid Chart
* Proven skill in risk management, scope control, budget tracking and stakeholder management.

**Leadership and communication**

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level status reporting.
* Able to influence without authority and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring structure to it quickly.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a results-oriented mindset and a commitment to delivering value to customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe or Certified Scrum Master certification.
* Experience leading platform migrations, monolith-to-microservices transitions or cloud modernization programs.
* Domain experience in fintech, e-commerce, SaaS or another regulated, high-scale environment.
* Exposure to observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana)
* Experience managing distributed teams across time zones.
* A Master's degree or MBA.

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**

* You have enabled 1–2 critical programs to hit key milestones on or near plan.
* Leadership has a single, trusted view of program health, risks and dependencies.
* Engineering teams see you as a technical peer who removes blockers rather than adds process.

f00fb5dc.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
f00fb5dc.description:
**Be part of something bigger!**
--------------------------------

  

As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy.

As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!

  

**I. Purpose of the Role**
--------------------------

The Solution Architect – Cloud is responsible for leading the architecture, governance, optimization, and operational oversight of Bekaert's cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure and Alibaba Cloud. The role ensures that cloud services are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient while enabling business innovation through modern cloud technologies, automation, data, and AI services.
  
As a cloud subject matter expert, the position drives the adoption of enterprise cloud best practices, Azure Landing Zones, cloud governance frameworks, FinOps disciplines, monitoring and observability standards, and cloud security controls. The role provides technical leadership for cloud transformation initiatives, application modernization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform engineering capabilities across the organization.
  
The <POSITION\_TITLE> collaborates closely with business stakeholders, application teams, security teams, architecture teams, and strategic service partners to define cloud standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and ensure successful delivery of cloud solutions aligned with Bekaert's business objectives.

**II. Roles and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

**Cloud Architecture & Design**
  

* Design, implement, and optimize enterprise-scale cloud architectures on Azure and Alibaba Cloud.
* Through understanding of Azure landing zones, Azure AI Landing Zones, subscription structures, networking, security, and governance frameworks.
* Architect highly available, resilient, and scalable solutions for business-critical applications.
* Lead cloud modernization and migration initiatives from on premises to cloud.
* Review application onboarding requirements and provide cloud architecture recommendations.

**Cloud Operations & Support**
  

* Ensure platform availability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Comprehensive knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) practices, including incident, problem, change, and capacity management.

* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities and implement preventive measures.
* Define and maintain operational standards, runbooks, and SOPs.

**FinOps & Cost Optimization**
  

* Monitor cloud consumption and spending across Azure and Alibaba Cloud environments.
* Implement FinOps practices for chargeback/showback and budget management.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities through Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot VMs, and resource optimization.
* Build cloud cost dashboards and executive reports.
* Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to forecast and manage cloud budgets.

**Monitoring & Observability**
  

* Define SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Implement proactive monitoring, logging, and automated remediation.

**Cloud Security & Governance**
  

* Well experience with cloud security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Manage IAM, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and security policies.
* Experienced with - Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy and Alibaba Cloud Security Center.
* Conduct security assessments and remediation activities.
* Support audits and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Networking & Connectivity**
  

* Hands experienced with :- VNets, VPCs, Private Endpoints, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Load Balancers, Application Gateways & DNS Services.
* Troubleshoot network performance and connectivity issues across hybrid environments.

**Automation & DevOps**
  

* Strong experience with developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using: Terraform, Bicep & ARM Templates.
* Automate operational processes using: PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python & Bash.
* Support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Implement platform automation and self-service capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management**
  

* Collaborate with application teams, security teams, vendors, and cloud providers.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship as and when required.
* Support cloud strategy discussions and technology roadmaps.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**III. Skills & Competencies**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Architecture.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native services.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, landing zones, and enterprise-scale cloud deployments.
* Experience designing and governing Azure Landing Zones, subscriptions, management groups, and policies.
* Expertise in cloud networking including VNets/VPCs, ExpressRoute, VPN, Private Endpoints, DNS, Load Balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Strong knowledge of cloud security, identity, access management, RBAC, PIM, and governance frameworks.
* Experience in Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Security Center, and compliance controls.
* Proven experience in cloud operations, service management, and operational governance.
* Strong understanding of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Experience leading major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and service improvement initiatives.
* Strong experience with monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Workbooks and CloudMonitor and Azure & Alibaba native backups and HA/DR strategies.
* Experience in FinOps, cloud cost optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and cloud financial management.
* Knowledge of Azure Reservations, Savings Plans, Azure Hybrid Benefit, and resource optimization strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or Bash scripting.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of containerization and modern application platforms such as AKS, Container Apps, App Services, and Functions.
* Experience supporting cloud migration, modernization, and transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and resilience strategies.
* Ability to define cloud standards, architecture patterns, governance controls, and best practices.
* Experience managing and governing services delivered by external vendors and managed service providers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance across cloud initiatives.
* Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator, Terraform Associate, or Alibaba Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Be bold and take the leap!**
------------------------------

  

Our Digital Advanced Solutions (ADS) team is a dynamic group of technologists from around the globe who consistently push boundaries in digital innovation, cyber resilience, data science, intelligent automation, cloud solutions, and new agile methodologies.
  
It is also good to know tht at Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

c8fba1b9.title: Senior Solution Support Engineer
c8fba1b9.description:
**About the Role:**
GSK’s Enterprise AI team is expanding its ability to architect, build, and run complex AI solutions across the enterprise. Senior Solutions Engineers sit at the intersection of technical architecture, hands-on AI engineering, and production operations — ensuring that AI capabilities translate reliably into production value and keep delivering it after go-live.
  
  
As a Senior Solutions Engineer you will own the technical solution design for complex AI integrations and personally build and operate them, working across EAI engineering, business technology teams, external partners, and strategic suppliers to ensure that what gets built can be deployed, integrated, maintained, and operated at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build, and review AI systems yourself — including LLM, agentic, and retrieval-based solutions — working within the architectural standards, engineering practices, and lifecycle framework set by the Staff Solutions Engineer, and contributing to how they evolve. You bring both the architectural depth to make the right design choices and the communication skills to earn confidence across technical and business audiences.
  
  
The role carries direct accountability for the AI products and integrations you deliver. Expect to spend roughly 40% of your time on production operations and support — keeping the lights on (KTLO), meeting SLAs and service metrics, and day-to-day coordination with strategic suppliers — and roughly 60% on engineering, with a deliberate focus on using that engineering to automate operations and steadily reduce the operational load.
  
  
You will use AI agents as part of your engineering and operations toolkit, supervising their output, to keep lowering the cost at which value is delivered for the solutions you own. As those solutions scale in deployment, you are responsible for identifying when the current engineered solution needs to be refactored and/or optimised, and for recommending and delivering that change — escalating portfolio-level cases to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists:**
As the Enterprise AI portfolio matures, the complexity of integration, deployment, and operations grows. Many of the most valuable AI opportunities require deep technical solutioning before engineering can begin, hands-on engineering to build them, and disciplined operation once they are live. In this role you will be the person who:
  
  

* Closes the gap between AI capability and enterprise deployment readiness through rigorous technical solutioning.
* Enables faster delivery by resolving integration complexity early, before it becomes a production blocker.
* Builds and ships production AI solutions hands-on, so that architectural decisions are grounded in working code rather than slideware.
* Keeps products healthy in production by owning KTLO, SLAs, and service metrics for the solutions you deliver.
* Automates the run through monitoring, AIOps, and AI agents, so reliability improves and the cost to operate falls as the portfolio grows.
* Governs the lifecycle by applying Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) discipline — stage gates, versioning, change control, and traceability — to every AI product you deliver.
* Raises the bar on solution quality by applying and contributing to architectural standards across complex engagements.
* Builds trust with business technology partners and enterprise architects through credible, well-grounded technical guidance.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Solution Architecture & Technical Design**

* Own technical solution design for complex AI integrations — from requirements through to detailed architecture, component selection, and integration specification.
* Define integration patterns for connecting AI capabilities with enterprise systems: SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, clinical data platforms, and GSK’s data infrastructure.
* Design for operability so that observability, SLOs, runbooks, and support requirements are built into the solution from the start rather than added after go-live.
* Produce solution architecture documentation that enables downstream engineering teams to build with confidence and minimises ambiguity at handoff.

**Hands-On AI Engineering (approx. 60% of role)**

* Build and ship production AI solutions — including LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and ML model serving — integrated with GSK enterprise systems.
* Write production-quality code and reference implementations, with tests, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and CI/CD for the AI systems you deliver.
* Apply the function’s AI engineering standards — prompt and model versioning, evaluation, secure deployment — and contribute improvements back to them.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, and tooling through hands-on benchmarking of quality, latency, cost, and risk, and recommend the right choice for each engagement.
* Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and platform engineers to take proven prototypes through to hardened, supportable production services, and own the handoff for your engagements.
* Use AI agents and coding assistants as part of daily engineering and operations, supervising and quality-assuring their output to lower the cost of delivering the solutions you own.

**Deployment Readiness & Technical Assurance:**

* Lead technical due diligence for complex deployments — identifying integration risks, data dependencies, security considerations, and operational requirements before build begins.
* Drive deployment readiness assessments ensuring AI solutions meet enterprise architecture standards, security policy, and regulatory requirements prior to production.
* Provide technical assurance throughout delivery — reviewing design decisions, flagging architectural drift, and escalating risks to engineering and product leadership.

**Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) for Enterprise AI:**

* Apply the PLM framework and stage gates to every AI product and integration you deliver, preparing the release evidence — evaluation results, security, data privacy, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Maintain accurate lifecycle records for your products — models, versions, prompt versions, dependencies, owners, and status — and drive change management, deprecation, and retirement.
* Ensure traceability and auditability across the lifecycle (data lineage, model and prompt versions, approvals, and decisions), suitable for a regulated pharma environment.
* Feed delivery and operational experience back into the PLM framework so that gates and criteria improve over time.

**Production Operations & Support (approx. 40% of role):**

* Own production operation and support for the AI integrations and products you deliver, including KTLO activities such as patching, upgrades, dependency and certificate management, and break-fix.
* Deliver against SLAs, SLOs, and service metrics (availability, latency, incident response and resolution times, change success rate, cost to serve) for your services, reporting performance to the Staff Solutions Engineer and business owners.
* Diagnose and resolve integration failures and lead incident response for your services, running post-incident reviews that drive root-cause fixes rather than repeated manual remediation.
* Work day to day with strategic suppliers and platform vendors on delivery — raising and tracking tickets, coordinating support escalations, and flagging performance or SLA issues to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
* Maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles for your services, and participate in the on-call and escalation model.
* Track operational toil for the services you own and convert it into automation.

**Intelligent Operations & Automation:**

* Build and operate observability for your services — monitoring of model quality, drift, hallucination and safety signals, latency, availability, and cost — with defined SLOs, alerting, and runbooks (AIOps / LLMOps / MLOps).
* Apply AI and agents to operations itself — automated triage, root-cause analysis, runbook execution, cost and capacity optimisation, and self-service support for product teams.
* Feed production usage and operational data back into design, evaluation, and PLM decisions so the portfolio improves with every release.
* Contribute to operating-model standards — ownership, support tiers, escalation, and the FDE-to-SE handoff — drawing on what you learn running real services.

**Solution Evolution & Cost-to-Value:**

* Track unit-economics and value metrics for the solutions you own (for example cost per transaction or outcome, and run cost against business value) and use them to prioritise optimisation work.
* As your solutions scale in deployment, identify when the current engineered solution needs to be refactored and/or optimised — for performance, reliability, cost, or maintainability — and make the case, plan the work, and deliver the change; escalate portfolio-level cases to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
* Monitor scale signals (usage growth, latency, cost per unit, incident trends, architectural limits) so that refactor and optimisation decisions are triggered early, and feed the outcomes into reusable patterns.
* Own the technical roadmap for integration capabilities, identifying where investment in common patterns will reduce cost and risk across the portfolio.
* Contribute to platform engineering decisions based on deployment and integration experience — feeding real-world constraints back into how the platform evolves.

**Partner Engagement & Technical Governance:**

* Represent EAI’s technical architecture in conversations with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and vendor partner teams.
* Build and maintain relationships with business technology leads across GSK to support alignment and accelerate approval of complex deployments.
* Contribute to EAI’s technical standards and architecture decision records, ensuring decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and reusable.

**Required Experience:**

* 15+ years in enterprise solution architecture, software or AI engineering, or technical pre-sales/post-sales engineering, with a track record of designing complex integrations.
* Recent, hands-on AI engineering experience: you have personally built and deployed production AI/ML or LLM-based systems (for example RAG, agentic workflows, model serving, evaluation pipelines) and can write, review, and debug code in languages such as Python.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data exchange standards.
* Practical experience with MLOps/LLMOps and cloud-native deployment (CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, observability) sufficient to make sound decisions about AI deployment, integration, and operability.
* Experience supporting production operations for enterprise platforms or AI services, including KTLO, SLA/SLO and service-metric delivery, incident and problem management, and on-call or escalation models.
* Experience using automation — and ideally AI agents — to reduce operational toil and the cost of delivery or operation.
* Working knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or equivalent lifecycle governance for technology, data, or AI products, including stage gates, versioning, change control, and retirement.
* Experience working with vendors or suppliers on delivery, including SLA follow-up, support escalations, and performance conversations.
* Track record of recognising when a system needs to be refactored or optimised as it scales, and delivering that work (performance tuning, re-architecture, cost optimisation).
* Experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharma, healthcare, or financial services preferred).
* Confidence engaging with senior technical and business stakeholders: running workshops, producing crisp architecture artefacts, and defending design choices.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in an AI-native company or equivalent AI-first engineering environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL or SRE practices (error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, change management) applied to AI and data platforms.
* Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation, or other quality and regulatory frameworks as they apply to AI and software products.
* Experience with agent frameworks, vector and graph data stores, model evaluation and red-teaming, and AI cost management (FinOps).

#AGTech
  
  
#GSK-LI
  
  
**Skills**
AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Microsoft Azure, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Performance Optimizations, Production Operations, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Solution Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

6856fe85.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
6856fe85.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A  

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

  

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

  

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

  

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

  

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

  

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

  

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

  

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

  

**More About Us**

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

c5ca6bbd.description:
**Company Description**
CAREERBLOC is a talent-focused organization dedicated to connecting skilled professionals with innovative businesses across technology and consulting domains. The company emphasizes career growth, skills development, and long-term partnership with both clients and professionals. CAREERBLOC works with organizations seeking specialized expertise in areas such as SAP, process optimization, and digital transformation. The team promotes an inclusive, collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and practical problem-solving. Joining CAREERBLOC offers opportunities to contribute to impactful projects while advancing professional capabilities.
  
**Role Description**
The SAP Signavio Architect / Techno-Functional Consultant is a full-time remote role responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing SAP Signavio-based solutions for business process management and transformation. In this role, the consultant collaborates with business and IT stakeholders to capture requirements, model end-to-end business processes, and align them with SAP solution architecture. Typical day-to-day tasks include configuring SAP Signavio, defining integration approaches with SAP and non-SAP systems, guiding process improvements, and documenting solution designs and standards. The consultant supports project delivery through workshops, demonstrations, and technical guidance, and provides ongoing advisory support on best practices for process governance and optimization. The role also involves working with cross-functional teams, supporting testing and deployment activities, and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with organizational goals.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Business Process modeling, analysis, and optimization, with experience using SAP Signavio or similar process management tools.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP Basis and related technical components to support system performance, stability, and secure integrations.
* Consulting skills including stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and preparation of clear documentation and recommendations.
* Solution Architecture experience in designing end-to-end SAP and SAP Signavio solutions, including integration patterns and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Integration skills covering SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP interfaces, APIs, and data flows to enable seamless business processes.
* Relevant experience in SAP ecosystems (e.g., S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform) and familiarity with business process transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical and process solutions.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in remote, cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications in SAP or process management are a plus.
