3b7e4e33.description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to lead the design, governance, and modernization of enterprise-wide technology solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in enterprise architecture, .NET-based application ecosystems, desktop engineering, and on-premises infrastructure environments. This role will be responsible for defining architecture standards, driving digital transformation initiatives, establishing technology roadmaps, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and technology strategies.

  

* **Role: Senior Enterprise Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define and govern enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Design scalable enterprise solutions using Microservices, Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), Event-Driven Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
* Drive modernization and transformation of legacy applications and enterprise platforms.
* Architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and disaster recovery-enabled solutions across distributed environments.
* Establish enterprise integration strategies across applications, databases, middleware, APIs, and third-party systems.
* Lead architecture decisions for .NET applications, desktop environments, virtualization platforms, networking, and on-prem infrastructure.
* Define infrastructure architecture covering compute, storage, security, networking, and enterprise platforms.
* Establish architecture governance processes, compliance controls, risk management practices, and security standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and leadership to align technology investments with business goals.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technology assessments, and technical governance forums.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor architects, developers, and engineering teams on enterprise architecture best practices.
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programs and technology adoption initiatives.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10-15 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, or Technology Strategy.
* Strong experience designing enterprise-scale .NET application ecosystems.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, and Architecture Governance models.
* Strong understanding of Desktop Engineering and Enterprise Endpoint Management environments.
* Extensive experience working with On-Prem Infrastructure, VMware virtualization, servers, storage, and enterprise platforms.
* Deep knowledge of Microservices Architecture, SOA, Event-Driven Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design.
* Proven experience in application modernization, legacy transformation, and enterprise platform consolidation programs.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, high availability, disaster recovery, and fault-tolerant architectures.
* Experience defining enterprise integration patterns, API strategies, middleware solutions, and data architecture standards.
* Expertise in infrastructure architecture, networking, security architecture, compute, and storage platforms.
* Strong knowledge of architecture governance, compliance frameworks, and risk management practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise-wide technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience collaborating with executive leadership and influencing strategic technology decisions.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

Your responsibilities will span across Azure IaaS/PaaS environments, automation, DevOps integration, and cloud governance, ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient solutions. This role combines presales architecture, customer consulting, and hands-on solution building.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers translate business needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures, and in many cases, build or prototype these solutions yourself.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and architecture of secure, high-performance Azure cloud environments for clients.
* Work with sales teams to understand customer requirements, pain points, and business objectives
* Develop and deliver cloud adoption strategies, including Azure migrations, infrastructure setups, and re-architecture plans.
* Architect and implement Virtual Networks, VNets, Subnets, VPNs, ExpressRoute, and Azure Firewall for secure connectivity.
* Provide thought leadership and best practices around HA/DR, backup strategies, and cloud security compliance.
* Guide clients through cloud governance, cost optimization, and resource monitoring using tools like Azure Monitor.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, ARM/Bicep templates, and Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Oversee deployment of Azure Data Services and integrations with Active Directory/Azure AD.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including DevOps, Security, Data, and Application developers.  Mentor junior team members and lead technical sessions, PoCs, and client workshops.
* Deliver technical demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs to customers

**Skills and Experience Required:**

* 5+ years of experience architecting and implementing enterprise solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of Azure IaaS, PaaS, and container services like AKS, ACI, App Services.  Solid grasp of networking, identity, and security fundamentals in Azure.
* Proven experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or customer-facing roles
* Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions
* Experience with PowerShell, Azure CLI, ARM/Bicep/Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Windows/Linux OS, cloud firewalls, and hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of database architecture with Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, and Cosmos DB.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud migration of applications and infrastructure.
* Experience with cost control, tagging strategy, and FinOps concepts.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, and relevant Indian regulations.
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP) is a plus.
* Experience with Kubernetes/Docker is preferred.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills for client-facing engagements.

**Candidate Attributes:**

* Highly collaborative, solution-oriented, and self-driven.
* Passion for learning and staying updated with Azure service enhancements and roadmap.
* Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work effectively in geographically dispersed teams.
* Must be certified in Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

**Why Join LDS Infotech?**

* Work with cutting-edge technologies across Azure, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, and DevSecOps.
* Someone who can sell solutions, not just explain technology
* Be part of large-scale transformation programs with Fortune 500 clients.
* Opportunity to lead innovation initiatives and contribute to LDS's cloud competency center.
* Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
* Continuous learning culture with certifications, workshops, and mentoring programs.

Job Description

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a highly experienced

Wipro Technologies stands at the forefront of digital transformation, delivering pioneering technology solutions that empower businesses to reinvent themselves. As part of our TS - TTMS group focused on Tech Transformation and Advancement, you will be contributing to a dynamic organization that values innovation, continuous learning, and inclusivity.

Joining our team means becoming part of a culture committed to fostering diversity, inclusivity, and personal growth. We provide opportunities to collaborate with cutting-edge technologies and work on impactful projects that address real-world challenges. Your expertise will enable us to shape the future of enterprise technology and help our clients realize their boldest ambitions.

͏

At Wipro Technologies, we believe in empowering our people to design their own reinvention journey. We are seeking self-motivated individuals passionate about continuous evolution in both their careers and skillsets.

Benefits of joining include:

* A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values your unique perspective and contributions.

If you are ready to build the next generation of enterprise architectures and help propel businesses into the future, we invite you to apply and join our innovative community at Wipro Technologies.

.

Experience: >10 YEARS
  
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**Summary of Position:**

  

We are seeking a **Principal Platform Engineer** to help lead the design, engineering, automation, and operation of enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platforms supporting cloud, datacenter, manufacturing, and edge environments.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for transforming architecture strategy into secure, scalable, automated, and supportable platform capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership and close collaboration across architecture, security, infrastructure, operations, and application teams.

The successful candidate will help drive modernization initiatives through cloud-native technologies, platform engineering practices, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, GitOps, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Platform Engineering**
------------------------

* Design, build, and operate enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platform capabilities across AWS, Azure, hybrid, on-premises, and edge environments.
* Translate architectural standards into reusable engineering patterns, automation, platform services, and operational capabilities.
* Lead technical design and implementation activities for strategic platform initiatives.
* Establish engineering best practices for platform development, deployment, lifecycle management, and operational support.
* Mentor engineering teams and provide technical guidance across platform-related initiatives.

**Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Platforms**
---------------------------------------

  + Cluster lifecycle management
  + Worker node design and scaling
  + Networking and ingress
  + Storage integration
  + Secrets and certificate management
  + Platform observability
  + Backup and recovery
  + Security controls and policy enforcement
* Support deployment patterns for:
  + Engineering & Validation environments
  + Production Edge environments
  + MES/SCADA-supporting platforms
  + GPU-enabled workloads
* Guide Kubernetes version management, upgrade strategies, supportability, and operational readiness.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**
---------------------------------------

* Develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment frameworks using Terraform and approved automation technologies.
* Implement GitOps deployment patterns using Argo CD, or approved alternatives.
* Drive automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration management, upgrades, compliance validation, and operational support.
* Build repeatable deployment patterns that reduce operational effort while improving consistency and quality.

**DevSecOps & Platform Reliability**
------------------------------------

* Integrate security, compliance, and operational controls into platform delivery processes.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, platform services, and Kubernetes lifecycle activities.
* Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities.
* Define and improve platform reliability, availability, observability, backup, and recovery capabilities.

**Qualification, Testing & Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop automated validation and qualification frameworks for:
  + Kubernetes releases
  + Infrastructure profiles
  + Storage integrations
  + Network integrations
  + Security controls
  + Platform services
  + Edge deployments
  + GPU-enabled configurations
* Contribute to platform certification and supportability programs.
* Support development of platform standards, support matrices, and operational runbooks.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, measurement, and operational feedback.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Partner with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, operations teams, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Help define engineering roadmaps and implementation plans.
* Contribute to platform strategy through practical implementation experience and operational insights.

**Key** **Responsibilities/Minimum** **Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree with 5+ years of total experience.

* Experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with **Kubernetes platforms** such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), OpenShift, RKE2, or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Linux administration, Containers and container platforms, Cloud networking and security, Observability and monitoring solutions
* Experience implementing highly available, secure, and scalable platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

* Experience with Argo CD, Helm, and modern Kubernetes platform tooling.

* Experience with Security Hub, CloudTrail, CloudFront, Audit Manager, Azure security services, and related governance tooling.
* Experience in manufacturing, edge computing, industrial, or distributed platform environments.
* Experience supporting disconnected or intermittently connected environments.
* Experience with GPU-enabled infrastructure and AI/ML platforms.

835c3868.title: Operations Program Manager
835c3868.description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we face unique support problems resulting from our scale and the types of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational support and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to meet the growing needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. Our support experience draws on a deep understanding of our products, the financial industry, money movement, and our customers’ products and users. Building this experience requires us to invest significant resources in talented teams of Stripes.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We’re looking for dynamic and entrepreneurial leaders who will define our strategy for scaling the Core Payments team, improve operational workflows, and maintain a best-in-class Operations program. If you like hard problems, are analytical, are comfortable operating with ambiguity, and enjoy finding creative solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end product launches across multiple regions as an integrated program. Develop and maintain detailed launch plans that serve as the central point of coordination across globally distributed and highly cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product Management, go-to-market, cross-functional review, Support, and other key partner teams.
* Drive operational excellence across the product launch lifecycle by designing, improving, and implementing scalable processes that strengthen stakeholder coordination, clarify dependencies, maintain alignment, and support consistent execution across regions.
* Monitor and report on progress through biweekly status updates to senior leadership while maintaining transparent documentation throughout.
* Support cross-functional collaboration by identifying and documenting teams’ responsibilities for product launches, proactively communicating blockers, and providing transparent status updates and relevant documentation, such as product launch Gantt charts, program plans, and scope details.
* Define and improve operating rhythms that support efficient collaboration across teams. Manage operational cadences for product launches and business reviews, and track Stripe Objectives and Key Results (SOKRs).
* Establish scalable launch frameworks and operational structures to simplify execution, improve cross-functional alignment, and support efficient multi-region product rollouts.

**Minimum Requirements**

* More than 7 years of total work experience, including 4 to 5 years in program management, consulting, or a similar role within a high-growth technology company, with a strong focus on managing strategic product initiatives from conception through implementation.
* A proven track record in process and project management, including creating operational processes, leading product roadmap reviews, and designing scalable systems in fast-paced environments.
* Skill in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines to support the timely delivery of products and features.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and executing complex projects while building collaboration across diverse teams and functions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including high-level planning and ongoing communication to align project goals with operations.
* The ability to present ideas, product updates, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders, including executives, to build alignment and understanding of project objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in program management, consulting, or a similar role within payments or fintech.
* Familiarity with roadmap management tools and planning frameworks, and knowledge of how to apply them to manage projects effectively.
* The ability to understand the company’s strategic goals and align the product roadmap accordingly.
* Skill in helping stakeholders prioritize product features and initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and resource availability.
* A deep understanding of global markets and the ability to contextualize decisions and processes to account for regional nuances.
* Experience implementing process improvements and change-management strategies to scale operations effectively.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

6f0c2463.title: Presales Solutions Consultant
6f0c2463.description:
Build the Future of Enterprise AI

Are you a
**top engineering graduate**
who enjoys solving problems, understanding technology, building things, and explaining how technology can create business impact?

Do you find yourself naturally exploring
**AI, GenAI, APIs, software products, and emerging technologies**
?

At
**Zycus**
, you can turn that technical curiosity into a career at the intersection of
**AI, Enterprise Technology, Consulting, and Business**
.

We are looking for exceptional Graduate Engineers to join our
**Pre-Sales / Solution Consulting**
team and work with some of the world's largest enterprises.

This is not a traditional sales role.

You will work with Sales, Product, Engineering, AI, and customers to understand complex business problems, design technology-led solutions, and demonstrate how
**AI-powered enterprise software**
can transform the way organizations work.

What You'll Do

Solve Real Business Problems With Technology

Enterprise customers come to us with complex problems—not just requests for software.

You will:

* Understand customer business processes and challenges.
* Break ambiguous problems into structured requirements.
* Translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Research industries, companies, and customer environments.
* Identify where software, automation, and AI can create measurable value.
* Work with experienced Solution Consultants to develop solution strategies.

Your job is to answer:

**"How can technology solve this customer's problem?"**

Bring AI Into Enterprise Solutions

AI is at the core of Zycus.

You will learn and work with:

* Generative AI
* LLMs
* AI Agents
* Intelligent Automation
* AI-powered workflows
* Conversational AI
* Data and analytics

You will help demonstrate how AI can automate work, generate insights, improve decision-making, and transform enterprise processes.

You will also be encouraged to experiment with AI tools to improve your own productivity and create better solutions.

**We want engineers who don't just know about AI—they use it.**

Design Technology Solutions

Working with senior Solution Consultants and Product teams, you will:

* Design solutions based on customer requirements.
* Understand system architecture and application workflows.
* Work with APIs, integrations, data, and enterprise systems.
* Configure and demonstrate product capabilities.
* Create solution prototypes and proof-of-concepts where required.
* Understand how enterprise SaaS applications integrate with customer ecosystems.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical solutions.

You will progressively develop from
**understanding the product → designing solutions → owning solution discussions.**

Create Compelling Product Demonstrations

One of the most important skills you will develop is the ability to
**show—not just tell—how technology solves a problem.**

You will:

* Build customized product demonstrations.
* Design demos around customer business scenarios.
* Present technical capabilities and business outcomes.
* Demonstrate AI-powered workflows.
* Explain complex technology to both technical and business audiences.
* Participate in customer presentations and solution workshops.

The goal isn't to demonstrate every feature.

The goal is to demonstrate:

**"Here's your problem. Here's how we solve it. Here's the value you get."**

Work With Global Enterprises

You will gain exposure to some of the world's largest organizations and work alongside experienced Sales and Solution Consulting teams across global markets.

You may participate in:

* Customer discovery sessions
* Technical workshops
* Solution presentations
* Product demonstrations
* Proof-of-concepts
* RFP/RFI responses
* Executive presentations
* Competitive analysis
* Account strategy

You will learn how enterprise technology decisions are actually made.

Work Across the Organization

You will collaborate with:

* Enterprise Sales
* Product Management
* Engineering
* AI/ML teams
* Customer Success
* Implementation
* Marketing

You will become the
**technical bridge between the customer and Zycus**
.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for
**elite Graduate Engineers**
with strong technical foundations and exceptional problem-solving ability.

Education

* B.E./B.Tech —
  **2027 graduates**
* Preferred disciplines:
* Computer Science Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Information Technology
* Artificial Intelligence
* Data Science
* Information Science
* Electronics & Communication
* Other strong engineering disciplines

We are particularly interested in candidates from
**top engineering institutions**
with strong academic and technical credentials.

What We Value

You don't need prior Pre-Sales experience.

We are looking for:

Strong Problem Solving

* Excellent analytical and structured-thinking ability.
* Ability to break complex problems into logical components.
* Strong aptitude for learning new concepts quickly.
* Comfort working with ambiguous problems.

Technical Curiosity

* Strong programming fundamentals.
* Understanding of software and technology concepts.
* Interest in SaaS, cloud, APIs, data, and enterprise technology.
* Ability to understand how different systems work together.

AI Fluency

We strongly value candidates who actively use AI.

You should be able to demonstrate how you have used tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* Claude
* Gemini
* Cursor
* GitHub Copilot
* Perplexity
* Other AI development or productivity tools

Even better if you have:

* Built an AI application.
* Built an AI Agent.
* Worked with an LLM or RAG.
* Created an AI-powered automation.
* Built a chatbot.
* Used AI to solve a real-world problem.
* Participated in an AI/technology hackathon.

Communication & Influence

Great Solution Consultants are excellent communicators.

You should be able to:

* Explain technical concepts simply.
* Present ideas confidently.
* Tell a compelling story around technology.
* Listen carefully and ask intelligent questions.
* Communicate with both engineers and business leaders.
* Influence without relying on authority.

You don't need to be a polished salesperson.

**We will teach you Pre-Sales.**

What we cannot easily teach is
**curiosity, intelligence, problem-solving ability, and the desire to understand technology deeply.**

What You'll Learn

At Zycus, you will develop a combination of skills that is difficult to acquire in a traditional engineering role.

Technology

Enterprise SaaS • APIs • Cloud • Integrations • Data • Architecture

AI

GenAI • LLMs • AI Agents • Intelligent Automation

Consulting

Discovery • Problem Definition • Solution Design • Business Analysis

Pre-Sales

Product Demonstrations • POCs • Solution Workshops • RFPs • Competitive Strategy

Business

Enterprise Buying • Digital Transformation • ROI • Value Selling

Communication

Storytelling • Executive Communication • Presentation • Influence

Where Can This Career Take You?

This role is designed to build the next generation of
**technology consultants and enterprise solution leaders**
.

As you grow, you can build a career toward:

**Solution Consultant → Senior Solution Consultant → Solution Architect → Principal Solution Architect**

or explore adjacent paths across:

**AI • Product Management • Enterprise Consulting • Sales Engineering • Customer Success • Business Value Consulting**

Why Zycus?

Zycus is an
**AI-first enterprise SaaS company**
transforming procurement for some of the world's largest organizations.

Our platform combines
**Source-to-Pay technology with Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, data, and intelligent workflows.**

You will get the opportunity to:

* Work with
  **Fortune 500 and global enterprises**
  .
* Work on real-world AI use cases.
* Learn enterprise SaaS and technology architecture.
* Work alongside Sales, Product, Engineering, and AI teams.
* Build solutions that impact large organizations.
* Develop both technical and business skills.
* Learn from experienced Solution Consultants and technology leaders.
* Build a career at the intersection of
  **AI + Technology + Business**
  .

The Profile We're Looking For

If you are someone who:

**Loves technology**

**Uses AI every day**

**Enjoys solving difficult problems**

**Can explain what you build**

**Enjoys interacting with people**

**Wants to understand how businesses work**

—you could be an exceptional Solution Consultant.

Start Your Career Where Technology Meets Business

Your engineering degree gives you the technical foundation.

At Zycus, you'll learn how to turn that foundation into
**solutions that solve real problems for the world's largest enterprises.**

**Build with AI. Solve complex problems. Work with global enterprises. Create impact.**

Join Zycus as a Graduate Solution Consultant

**Location:**

**Description**
You will engage directly with our dealers to develop a deep understanding of our solutions through formal sales and technical training sessions. In this role, you will support our field sales team by responding to requests for proposals and information, conducting product demonstrations, and addressing dealer and end-user inquiries.
  
  
We are looking for a technical expert who is ready to "build it, break it, and fix it". This role offers the unique opportunity to manage your own home test lab to vet new Brivo products. If you're passionate about technology, customer service, and adhering to good operational practices, we invite you to join our team.
  
  
This position is based in Bangalore, India and covers the APAC territory.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive sales growth among independent resellers in the assigned territory by serving as a primary sales and technical advisor for Brivo products and third-party API integrations.
* Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, customer engagements, and field events for resellers and end-users, both virtually and on-site.
* Provide technical and design support to resellers and Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), including project design, Bills of Materials (BOMs), competitive differentiation, and remote/on-site support for escalated issues.
* Coordinate technical aspects of customer projects, including multi-site and multi-region deployments, phased rollout planning, technical QA, post-installation health checks, and technical account reviews for large accounts.
* Strengthen reseller technical capabilities through Brivo University and product certification training, train-the-trainer programs, and ongoing technical enablement.
* Collaborate with product management and internal teams to communicate customer needs, improve reseller performance, and develop and maintain technical documentation.
* Maintain knowledge of regional competitors, including local VMS and cloud providers, to support RSMs and resellers with technical differentiation and competitive opportunities.

**Skills, Expertise & Qualifications**

* Experience in physical security or access control, with 5+ years as a pre-sales technical professional OR relevant field experience selling, installing, or programming Brivo systems.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Proficiency with CRM, Google Workspace, and design tools.
* Previous experience crafting responses to functional and technical requirements for RFIs and RFPs.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver engaging product demonstrations to dealers and end users, both virtually and in person.
* Experience in creating a bill of materials (BOM).
* Proficient in delivering pre-sales and technical training content.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present ideas clearly and concisely.
* Confident, energetic, and enthusiastic approach.
* Capable of lifting 25 kg.
* Possession of a valid Passport and willingness to travel 25%-50%, including outside the assigned territory; proximity to a major airport is required.

**About Brivo**
Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.
  
  
As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.
  
  
*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

8004967e.title: Sr Principal Solution Consultant
8004967e.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.

* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.

* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.

4a6631f3.title: Solutions Engineer III
4a6631f3.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**About the Company:**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

2. Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
3. Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.

**Required Skills:**

* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

**Qualifications:**

554df447.description:
**Join our Team**

About this opportunity:

We are seeking a Cloud Architect to design, define, and govern cloud-native infrastructure for SD SL core network deployments. The role covers the cloud platform that hosts 5G and 4G core network functions, including Cloud Network Functions (CNFs), and ensures they meet performance, availability, security, and operational requirements. The architect works across network, cloud, and delivery teams to move solutions from design through deployment and into operation.

What will you do:

* Design the end-to-end cloud infrastructure for core network workloads, including compute, storage, networking, and orchestration layers.
* Define cloud platform architecture for CNF hosting, covering Kubernetes-based and NFV-based deployments as applicable.
* Specify placement, resource allocation, and scaling strategies for core network functions such as AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, UDM, AUSF, NRF, and NSSF.
* Ensure cloud designs meet telecom-grade requirements for latency, throughput, high availability, geo-redundancy, and disaster recovery.
* Define cloud security architecture, including network segmentation, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance controls.
* Collaborate with core network architects on SBI, interworking, and protocol-level requirements that affect cloud design.
* Lead architecture reviews, design documentation, and solution approval with internal and customer stakeholders.
* Evaluate cloud vendors, platforms, and tools, and make technology recommendations with clear trade-off analysis.
* Support deployment planning, troubleshoot architecture-level issues during rollout, and provide guidance to delivery teams.
* Drive automation, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD practices for core network cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices.

The skills you bring:

* Proven experience architecting cloud platforms for telecom or mission-critical workloads.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, containers, and service mesh concepts.
* Working knowledge of virtualization and NFV concepts, including OpenStack or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of 4G/5G core network architecture, including EPC and 5GC network functions and their interfaces.
* Familiarity with telecom protocols relevant to cloud deployment, such as HTTP/2, Diameter, GTPv2, and PFCP.
* Experience with infrastructure as code tools (for example, Terraform, Ansible, or Helm).
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including overlay and underlay networks, load balancing, and traffic steering.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present architecture decisions to executive and technical audiences.

  
Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with 5G Standalone (SA) deployments in a cloud or CNF environment.
* Experience with EPC-to-5GC migration or interworking, including NSA to SA transition.
* Knowledge of network slicing, IMS, or VoNR architecture.
* Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (for example, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Red Hat OpenShift) or Kubernetes (CKA or CKAD).
* Experience working in multi-vendor environments and with customer-facing governance processes.

* Define architecture for model observability, performance monitoring, and continuous learning feedback loops.

**Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.

* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
* Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.

* Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
* Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
* Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
* Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role shaping customer experience architecture within one of the world's leading enterprise platforms.
* The opportunity to define architectural strategies for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.
* A collaborative, innovation-focused culture with organizational influence and visibility to senior leadership.

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

f5fd9a7d.title: Senior Software Architect ( AWS, .NET)
f5fd9a7d.description:
**Description**

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Native AWS Software Architect to lead the design and development of cutting-edge cloud-hosted solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in AWS, microservices architecture, SaaS product development, and modern web application frameworks. This role requires a hands-on leader who can drive architectural decisions, mentor engineering teams, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud applications.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of cloud-hosted web applications for the insurance industry from network infrastructure design to user experience, database schema, data models, workflow automation, and end-to-end integration testing.  
   • Define and own architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AWS-native SaaS products.  
   • Collaborate closely with product management, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.  
   • Drive domain-driven designs for data models, APIs, and data products.  
   • Architect and implement microservices using modern frameworks and container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS).  
   • Oversee CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes for rapid, reliable, and secure deployments.  
   • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs with a focus on performance and scalability.  
   • Develop functional, responsive, and accessible front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS/SCSS, TypeScript, Angular/React, and modern UI component libraries (e.g., Kendo UI, Infragistics).  
   • Ensure security best practices in application architecture, including IAM policies, encryption, API security, and compliance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2).  
   • Champion cloud-native principles and serverless architectures using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, and other AWS managed services.  
   • Work with AWS data services, including Redshift, RDS, Aurora, and S3, for building scalable data-driven applications.  
   • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate emerging AWS services and architectural approaches.  
   • Mentor and guide development teams in architecture decisions, code quality, and performance optimization.  
   • Support UI automation testing alongside development activities to ensure high-quality deliverables.  
   • Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams for automated testing, monitoring, and application observability using tools like CloudWatch, X-Ray, and Open Telemetry.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field; Master’s preferred.  
 • 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with 2+ years in an AWS cloud-native architect role.  
 • Proven experience designing and implementing AWS-native SaaS products and complex full-stack applications.  
 • Strong expertise in .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core, and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React, TypeScript).  
 • Experience with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway) and microservices deployed on ECS/EKS.  
 • Proficiency with SQL and database programming for both RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and AWS data solutions (Redshift, Aurora, DynamoDB).  
 • Experience designing secure, multi-tenant SaaS architectures.  
 • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in cross-functional product teams.  
 • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK.  
 • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, AWS Code Pipeline, or similar tools.  
 • Experience implementing application monitoring and observability.  
 • Strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.

Preferred Skills  
 • Experience with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, or Kafka.  
 • Understanding of cost optimization strategies in AWS environments.  
 • Experience integrating with third-party APIs and services.  
 • Knowledge of insurance industry platforms and regulatory compliance considerations.  
 • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

Why Join Us?  
 • Opportunity to shape the future of cloud-native SaaS solutions in the insurance space.  
 • Work with cutting-edge AWS services and modern development practices.  
 • Collaborate with talented engineers and architects in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

4d5bdb6f.title: Principal Engineer (Data science + AI architect)
4d5bdb6f.description:
**Company Description**

  

**We're Nagarro,** we are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

  

**Job Description**

  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Total experience 11+ years.
* Must have experience to design, build and run GenAI and Agentic AI solutions inside enterprise systems, fitting AI into existing systems, security rules and budgets.
* Must have ability to translate ambiguous business problems into durable technical architectures.
* Must have strong ML fundamentals; how models are trained, tested and compared; spotting overfitting and weak data, deep learning basics; embeddings, classification, ranking models
* Should be able to architect and implement scalable ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents) aligned with business objectives.
* Must have experience in data science, ML engineering or AI architecture, with at least 5 years leading ML solutions from design to production.
* Should have expertise in Python, SQL and Solid statistics, including outlier detection and error metrics
* Should have exposure to time series forecasting.
* Should have production experience with regression and tabular ML: feature engineering, model selection, calibration, uncertainty (conformal or quantile intervals) and explainability (SHAP, coefficients).
* Must have experience with hierarchical forecasting or reconciliation, and prompt-injection testing.
* Should have hands-on experience with embeddings, vector search and hybrid retrieval, and with LLM applications: tool calling, retrieval-grounded generation, citations, guardrails and evaluation.
* Should have hands-on experience for building conversational agent, with multi-turn session memory and tool calling into the multiple engines and the semantic layer.
* Must have experience on a major cloud: pipelines, model registry, drift monitoring, retraining and low-latency serving.
* Should have experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Gemini, Vector Search), or equivalent on another cloud.
* Design retrieval-grounded generation with citations, input and output guardrails, human approval for actions, and layered, attack-tested prompt-injection protection.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Understanding the clients business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex GenAI workflows that combine LLMs, tools, APIs, structured data, and user context.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for prompt design, model integration, evaluation, and observability.
* Drive GenAI platform building reusable components, SDKs, and frameworks used across multiple teams or products.
* Partner with product, design, data, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
* Review critical designs and codebases, unblock teams on complex technical challenges, and raise the overall engineering bar.
* Lead technical discovery and solutioning for high-impact initiatives, including client or executive-facing workshops when required.
* Ensure enterprise readiness: security, privacy, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
* Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the clients requirements.
* Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation
* Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high-level design of the application for the developers
* Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
* Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it
* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects
* Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
* Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.

**Role family:**
Business Consulting / Solution Architecture
  
  
**Technology focus:**
Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.
* Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance.
* Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria.

Leadership and Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.
* Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs.
* Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning.
* Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation.
* Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable.

**Technology and Platform Exposure**
**Front end and mobile:**
Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility.
  
  
**Back end and APIs:**
Spring Boot, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management.
  
  
**Cloud and containers:**
Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance.
  
  
**Integration and Middleware:**
API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security.
  
  
**Engineering and delivery:**
Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy.
  
  
**Operations:**
Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition.

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

3b468c94.title: Customer-S&S-Genesys Cloud Architect (CCaaS)-Manager, Technical Transformation
3b468c94.description:
**Customer**

The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.

**Position Summary**

**Level:** Genesys Cloud Manager(CCaaS), Technical Transformation

**Work you’ll do:**

Deloitte is seeking a Genesys Cloud Architect with deep expertise in cloud contact center platforms and a strong command of the latest AI capabilities. You will design and lead the delivery of intelligent customer engagement solutions that combine Genesys Cloud CX with generative AI, conversational AI, and advanced analytics. You will translate complex client objectives into scalable, secure, and AI-enabled architectures, and you will help organizations move from traditional contact centers to predictive, self-service, and agent-assist experiences that measurably improve customer outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Genesys Cloud CX engagements, including routing, IVR, digital channels, workforce engagement, and analytics
* Architect AI-driven experiences, including virtual agents, generative AI assistants, intent recognition, and self-service automation, integrated with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities (such as Genesys Cloud AI Studio, Agent Copilot, and Agent Assist)
* Design integrations with large language models and AI platforms (such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Anthropic Claude) using Genesys Cloud Data Actions, APIs, and middleware
* Define retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and knowledge base strategies to ground AI responses in client content, with appropriate guardrails
* Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI in the contact center, covering data privacy, bias monitoring, human-in-the-loop escalation, and model performance tracking
* Design speech and text analytics pipelines, including real-time sentiment, quality scoring, and conversation summarization, to drive operational insight
* Partner with business stakeholders and delivery teams to translate requirements into AI-enabled technical designs and business cases
* Conduct solution reviews, performance assessments, and risk evaluations throughout the project lifecycle
* Guide migrations from legacy on-premise or other CCaaS platforms to Genesys Cloud
* Mentor consultants and developers on Genesys Cloud configuration, AI tooling, and architectural patterns
* Contribute to thought leadership, proposals, and AI-enabled accelerators within the CX practice

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of experience in contact center technology, with at least 5 years hands-on with Genesys Cloud CX
* Genesys Cloud certification (Architect, Admin, or Developer) preferred
* Deep knowledge of Genesys Cloud Architect, Data Actions, APIs, and Journey capabilities
* Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompt design, evaluation, and integration into production systems
* Familiarity with conversational AI platforms, NLU, and voice bot design
* Experience integrating contact center platforms with CRM and enterprise systems (such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics)
* Strong understanding of WFM, Quality Management, and reporting/analytics within CCaaS environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executive audiences
* Willingness to travel to client sites as required

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act, PCI, HIPAA) in regulated industries
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval architectures
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Genesys Cloud Platform API development
* Prior consulting experience in a client-facing role

**What You'll Bring**

* A consultative mindset and a passion for using AI to improve customer experiences
* Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and the discipline to evaluate them against business value
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Leadership skills to guide cross-functional teams toward shared outcomes

**Manager-level success measures**

* Architecture connects business outcomes to implementable Genesys Cloud and AI capabilities.
* AI-enabled journeys have clear controls, escalation paths, and operational ownership.
* Delivery teams understand design decisions and dependencies, with limited avoidable rework.
* Client stakeholders have visibility into progress, risks, and readiness for launch and operations.
* Teams are coached effectively and contribute to sustained client relationships

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
