089f5d05.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2)
089f5d05.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, the Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

13cefe90.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-18

  

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you a strong delivery leader within digital products and platforms, who enjoys leading cross-functional teams and creating real business impact through technology? Do you thrive in complex environments where you balance product vision, engineering excellence, and operational performance?
  
  
If yes – keep reading, as this might be your next role!
  
  
We are looking for a Platform Product Delivery Manager to join IKEA Group Digital. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of digital products within a platform subdomain, ensuring they are built and operated with quality, scalability, and business value in mind.
  
  
You are someone who inspires others, builds strong teams, and creates clarity in complex situations. You combine a strong customer focus with a deep understanding of technology and delivery, and you have the ability to translate insights into tangible product outcomes.
  
  
Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high-quality digital products that make a difference.
  
  
Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
  
Strong experience in leading cross-technical product and engineering teams
  
Good understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices
  
Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome-oriented ways of working
  
Ability to define and measure success through KPIs and OKRs
  
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  
Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
  
A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers. [
  
  
You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies.
  
  
You will also play a key role in building strong, high-performing teams and enabling ways of working that support speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  
  
Role and Responsibilities:
  
The SAP BASIS and Infrastructure Manager is responsible for managing SAP technical operations, infrastructure services, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), system availability, performance, security, roles and authorizations, and operational support across development, test, and production environments.
  
  
The role ensures that SAP systems and supporting infrastructure are stable, secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
Scope of Responsibilities
  
  
SAP BASIS Management
  
Manage and support SAP landscapes, including development, quality assurance, and production systems.
  
Oversee SAP installations, upgrades, patches, kernel updates, system copies, refreshes, migrations, and decommissioning.
  
Manage SAP transports across system landscapes in accordance with change-management procedures.
  
Monitor SAP system health, availability, performance, and capacity.
  
Manage background jobs, interfaces, RFC connections, printers, certificates, and technical configurations.
  
Coordinate support packs, enhancement packages, SAP Notes, technical upgrades, and remediation activities.
  
Troubleshoot and resolve SAP system, database, integration, and performance-related issues.
  
Ensure effective incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
  
  
2. SAP Solution Manager
  
Manage and administer SAP Solution Manager environments and related technical components.
  
Support system monitoring, technical monitoring, application monitoring, and alert management.
  
Manage change and transport processes using SAP Solution Manager capabilities.
  
Support IT service management, incident, problem, and change-management processes.
  
Maintain system documentation, technical inventory, system relationships, and solution documentation.
  
Coordinate maintenance planner activities, upgrade planning, system validation, and technical readiness assessments.
  
Support root-cause analysis, business-process monitoring, and service-level reporting.
  
Ensure Solution Manager is integrated with the SAP landscape and relevant support processes.
  
  
3. SAP BTP
  
Manage and support SAP Business Technology Platform services and environments.
  
Administer BTP accounts, global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, subscriptions, and service assignments.
  
Manage BTP security, trust configuration, identity federation, destinations, certificates, and connectivity.
  
Support SAP BTP services such as Integration Suite, Cloud Connector, API Management, Extension Suite, and application runtimes, where applicable.
  
Monitor BTP applications, integrations, usage, performance, availability, and service consumption.
  
Coordinate BTP provisioning, configuration, upgrades, incident resolution, and lifecycle management.
  
Ensure BTP environments comply with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and cost-management requirements.
  
Work with application and integration teams to support cloud-based extensions and interfaces.
  
  
4. SAP Roles and Authorizations
  
Own the technical administration and governance of SAP roles, profiles, users, and authorizations.
  
Design, create, modify, and maintain SAP roles in accordance with approved business requirements and security policies.
  
Support composite, single, derived, and business roles as applicable.
  
Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, access changes, and emergency access processes.
  
Coordinate role testing, approval, transport, and deployment across SAP environments.
  
Support segregation-of-duties analysis, critical-access reviews, and remediation activities.
  
Coordinate periodic user-access reviews and role recertification with business process owners and information security.
  
Maintain appropriate controls for privileged access, firefighter/emergency access, and technical users.
  
Ensure roles and authorizations are documented and aligned with the approved organizational and process structure.
  
Support audits and provide evidence relating to access controls, authorization design, and remediation activities.
  
  
5. Infrastructure Management
  
Manage the infrastructure supporting SAP applications, including servers, databases, operating systems, storage, networks, and cloud platforms.
  
Ensure infrastructure availability, resilience, scalability, and performance.
  
Coordinate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
  
Manage operating-system and database maintenance in line with SAP requirements.
  
Establish monitoring, alerting, capacity-planning, and performance-management processes.
  
Ensure appropriate backup, restore, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity arrangements.
  
Coordinate infrastructure support with internal teams, hosting providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  
  
6. Security and Compliance
  
Ensure SAP, Solution Manager, BTP, and infrastructure environments comply with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.
  
Support vulnerability assessments, security patching, audit activities, access reviews, and segregation-of-duties controls.
  
Coordinate remediation of security findings, SAP vulnerabilities, authorization risks, and infrastructure issues.
  
Maintain appropriate system logging, monitoring, privileged-access controls, and technical evidence.
  
Ensure compliance with change-management, access-management, and operational-control requirements.
  
  
7. Service Delivery and Operations
  
Own the delivery of SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, roles and authorizations, and infrastructure services in line with agreed service levels.
  
Lead the resolution of critical incidents and coordinate cross-functional technical teams.
  
Establish and maintain operational procedures, support models, escalation processes, and knowledge articles.
  
Review service performance, recurring issues, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  
Maintain accurate technical documentation covering system architecture, integrations, dependencies, configurations, and operational procedures.
  
Coordinate production deployments, maintenance windows, cutover activities, and rollback planning.
  
  
8. Project and Change Management
  
Provide technical leadership for SAP implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, BTP initiatives, and transformation programs.
  
Review technical designs for SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, infrastructure, security, and authorization components.
  
Prepare technical estimates, resource plans, dependencies, risks, and implementation timelines.
  
Coordinate technical testing, security testing, role testing, cutover planning, go-live activities, and post-production support.
  
Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, documented, and implemented with minimal business disruption.
  
  
9. Vendor and Stakeholder Management
  
Manage relationships with SAP, infrastructure, cloud, hosting, security, and application-support vendors.
  
Review vendor performance, service quality, deliverables, and contractual commitments.
  
Coordinate with business stakeholders, application teams, information security, internal audit, enterprise architecture, and process owners.
  
Communicate system status, risks, incidents, planned maintenance, access issues, and improvement initiatives.
  
Manage budgets, licensing considerations, BTP consumption, resource requirements, and third-party services.
  
  
10. Team Leadership
  
Lead, mentor, and develop SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, authorization, and infrastructure team members.
  
Define roles, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations.
  
Ensure appropriate support coverage, on-call arrangements, knowledge transfer, and succession planning.
  
Promote automation, standardization, role optimization, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  
Ensure the team follows IT service-management, security, compliance, and governance processes.
  
Must demonstrate strong People Leadership capabilities enabling teams to achieve individual and collective goals and ability to build high performing teams.
  
Must lead by example in line with IKEA values and leadership compass.
  
Should demonstrate strong rooting in relevant content, be it technology or function.
  
Is a strategic thinker and is able to translate organizational & domain objectives into subdomain level strategic and operational goals with clarity, focus while staying anchored on business value delivered.
  
Has demonstrated experience in working with senior stakeholders and ability to understand stakeholder expectations, build good relationships and maintain high stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Proven Problem solving and critical thinking skills to steer through complex or demanding scenarios with a positively and “can do” mindset.
  
  
Experience required:
  
Extensive experience (15+ years) in managing and implementing large-scale SAP projects, specifically within BASIS/Infra modules, preferably in a retail environment.
  
Proven track record of leadership with at least 5-7 years in a senior management or Director role, leading high-performing teams.
  
Deep functional and technical expertise in SAP BASIS/Infra. Experience with S/4HANA is highly desirable.
  
Strong understanding of retail business processes and how SAP applications can be leveraged to drive efficiency and competitive advantage.
  
Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management abilities, with a knack for influencing and collaborating across all levels of an organization.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) You will be part of Group Digital, where we set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast-moving and uncertain world. We develop and operate digital products and platforms that support the entire IKEA value chain and enable better experiences for both customers and co-workers. You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

eb713a34.description:
**Toyota Automated Logistics** is a part of the Toyota Industries Group and specializes in warehouse automation and material handling solutions. We work on innovative technologies and solutions such as automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, and other warehouse automation solutions that help businesses improve operational efficiency and productivity.

* **Methodology:** Waterfall (Phased Execution: Initiation, Design, Manufacturing, Installation, Commissioning, Closeout)
* **Travel Requirements:** Up to 30–50% (depending on phase of site commissioning)

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Waterfall Phase Gate Management:** Lead large-scale warehouse automation projects through structured Waterfall milestones (Engineering Sign-off, Factory Acceptance Testing, Mechanical/Electrical Installation, Commissioning, and Handover).
* **Scope & Change Control:** Manage highly detailed technical scopes. Prevent scope creep by strict documentation and pricing of Change Orders for any equipment or software modifications.
* **Project Schedule & Milestone Tracking:** Maintain the Master Project Schedule (e.g., Gantt charts). Forecast long-lead procurement items (conveyors, AS/RS cranes, racking) to avoid site delays.
* **Budget Tracking:** Manage multi-million dollar equipment and labor budgets, tracking progress payments and billing milestones tied to delivery phases.
* **Monitor & Control Supplier deliverables :** Coordinate with suppliers for complete deliverables from date of P.O issue till P.O completion, including warranty period. Ensure timely receipt of dispatch documents from suppliers and handover to Finance team for accounting. Coordinate with Finance team for timely supplier payment releases as per agreed terms.
* **Reporting:** Prepare & update project progress to customers and internal stakeholders on Weekly & Monthly basis
* **Payment Reconciliation :** Ensure payment collection from customers as per the deliverables and payment terms agreed with customers
* **On-Site Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination:** Supervise mechanical and electrical installation contractors on-site to ensure work adheres to engineering drawings and safety protocols.

**Technical & Professional Requirements**

* **Industry Experience:** 2–6 years of project management or coordination in **intra-logistics, warehouse automation, material handling, conveyor systems, or industrial construction**.
* **Methodology:** Proven experience executing capital expenditure (Capex) hardware/software integration projects using **Waterfall** methodologies.
* **Technical Skills:** Ability to read and interpret mechanical layout drawings, electrical schematics, and system sequence of operations.
* **Software Proficiency:** Strong skills in project scheduling tools like **Microsoft Project**. Should have hands on experience working in Microsoft Planner.
* **Preferred / Nice-to-Have:** Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering; PMP certification or equivalent field experience in material handling.

As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.

221100

10044

Key job responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
* Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.

You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.

AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. * 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience

f4ad4e74.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
f4ad4e74.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own execution for large, cross-functional technical programs at Quince to help us scale and grow in existing geographies or launch new countries. You will work across product, engineering, business, and legal to align on scope, priorities, and dependencies. You will typically work with several engineering teams, product and business counterparts across the globe, and a commercial deadline.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run several large, cross-functional programs at a time and be accountable for their delivery, on both timeline and impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end delivery, from scoping through launch and post-launch measurement.
* Work directly with engineering & product leads and architects on technical/business trade-offs.
* Drive alignment across US and India teams, including product and business leadership in Pacific time.
* Surface risks early and push for decisions when teams are stuck.
* Communicate status, risk, and asks to senior leadership in clear writing.
* Build the execution mechanisms this team needs as it scales.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 10-14 years of experience, with the last several as a TPM on product programs that shipped to customers.
* A bias for ownership. You take charge of ambiguous problems without waiting to be assigned, and you hold your ground with senior stakeholders when you believe the call is wrong.
* A record of owning launches end to end.
* Technical depth. An engineering background, or experience shaping architecture and design decisions.
* Experience running programs across time zones with US or headquarters stakeholders.
* Strong written communication with senior stakeholders.

****Good to have**
:**

* E-commerce, D2C, or marketplace experience
* Exposure to global expansion, localization, or regulatory programs

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

* Experience supporting data platform modernization or migration programs in large enterprises.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations relevant to customers in India.
* Experience mentoring technical presales professionals or leading cross-account technical initiatives.

**About Darwinbox**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
  
  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**Location**
Bangalore or Mumbai, India (Field / Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience**
6 – 12 years
  
  
**Skills**

* HCM (Human Capital Management) solution consulting
* Functional pre-sales / solution consulting
* Discovery workshops and business requirements documentation
* Process mapping and process flow design
* RFP (Request for Proposal) response development
* Product demonstrations to enterprise prospects
* Value-based selling
* Solution design artefacts — context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions
* HR business processes and workforce management domain knowledge
* C-level stakeholder engagement
* Cross-industry enterprise solutioning

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of legacy ERP HR modules and competing SaaS HCM platforms (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday) for competitive positioning
* HRBP (HR Business Partner) experience

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct discovery workshops with enterprise prospects to formulate and document business requirements, HR processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Design value-based HCM solutions to client problems and communicate them to customers, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders through process flows, context diagrams, and functional/technical descriptions.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and produce solution overviews that map customer business initiatives to the HCM solution.
* Prepare and deliver functional product demonstrations of the HCM solution tailored to customer evaluation criteria.
* Develop solution expertise across multiple industries and present the HCM value proposition to enterprise customers in each vertical.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with key customer stakeholders, influencers, and decision-makers across the evaluation cycle.
* Produce competitive positioning content comparing the HCM platform against legacy ERP and competing SaaS HCM systems.
* Collaborate with the sales team to develop differentiated value propositions, themes, and customer messaging.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum: MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent relevant work experience in HCM consulting.
* 6–12 years of experience in HCM consulting or HRBP roles.
* Demonstrated experience in value-based selling within an HCM consulting environment.
* No HCM/HR certification required.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

29cbcea1.title: Consultant | D365 F&O - PMO | Mumbai | Emerging ERP Solutions
29cbcea1.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

  
  

As a Consultant within Deloitte's Enterprise Technology & Performance practice, you will support delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP transformation programs and D365 application support engagements by providing PMO, governance, reporting, project controls, and stakeholder coordination services across multiple workstreams.

  
  

The role requires strong coordination, reporting, governance, and project tracking capabilities. You will work closely with Program Managers, Project Managers, Functional Leads, Technical Leads, Client Stakeholders, Support Managers, and PMO leadership to ensure effective governance throughout the implementation, rollout, enhancement, and application support lifecycle.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

Program Governance & PMO Support

  
  

* Support establishment and execution of project governance processes, standards, templates, and reporting mechanisms.

* Coordinate governance forums including project reviews, workstream reviews, operational reviews, and steering committee preparation.

* Maintain governance artefacts including RAID logs, decision logs, action trackers, and project documentation repositories.

* Support stage-gate reviews, project audits, quality reviews, and governance compliance activities.

* Ensure governance reporting deadlines and PMO standards are consistently met.

* Support PMO governance across implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements.

  
  

Project Planning & Controls

  
  

* Support maintenance of integrated project schedules and milestone plans.

* Track project progress against approved plans and highlight schedule variances.

* Monitor key milestones and deliverables across business and technology workstreams.

* Support management of dependencies and critical path activities.

* Follow up with workstream leads on outstanding actions and deliverables.

* Support monitoring of project health indicators and governance KPIs.

  
  

D365 ERP Delivery Governance

  
  

* Support governance and tracking across D365 implementation workstreams including Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, Data Migration, Integrations, Technical, Testing, and Change Management.

* Track design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities against agreed plans.

* Monitor data migration readiness, integration milestones, and environment readiness activities.

* Track SIT and UAT progress, defect metrics, and readiness status.

* Support cutover planning by maintaining cutover trackers and readiness checkpoints.

* Assist with go-live readiness reviews and post-go-live stabilization reporting.

* Support transition activities from implementation to support and operations teams.

  
  

D365 ERP Support & Managed Services Governance

  
  

* Support PMO and governance activities for D365 ERP support, enhancement, application management, managed services, and operate engagements.

* Track incoming incidents, service requests, enhancement requests, defects, and support tickets against agreed service levels.

* Monitor SLA compliance, ticket aging, backlog trends, response times, resolution timelines, and support performance metrics.

* Prepare operational dashboards covering ticket volumes, backlog, SLA performance, and enhancement delivery status.

* Support governance reviews related to support operations, enhancement releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Coordinate with functional, technical, and support teams to ensure timely closure of incidents and service requests.

* Track release schedules, deployment activities, and enhancement delivery milestones.

* Support service transition activities following ERP go-live.

  
  

Reporting & Management Information

  
  

* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, executive packs, meeting minutes, and governance presentations.

* Consolidate reporting inputs from workstream leads and validate data quality.

* Track and report key performance indicators related to schedule, risks, issues, defects, dependencies, milestones, SLA compliance, and support operations.

* Support creation of management reporting using Excel, Power BI, and project management tools.

* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for client and internal leadership reviews.

  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency & Change Control

  
  

* Maintain RAID registers and monitor mitigation and resolution actions.

* Support identification, tracking, and escalation of delivery risks and issues.

* Track cross-workstream dependencies and communicate potential impacts.

* Track change requests and support established change governance processes.

* Monitor overdue actions, unresolved risks, and critical dependencies and escalate through appropriate governance channels.

  
  

Financial & Resource Reporting

  
  

* Support budget tracking, effort tracking, forecast updates, and financial reporting.

* Prepare utilization and resource capacity reports.

* Support resource onboarding, offboarding, and resource tracking activities.

* Support vendor and implementation partner governance through reporting and action tracking.

* Provide reporting support for project and support engagement financial performance.

  
  

Stakeholder Management

  
  

* Coordinate activities between client teams, delivery teams, workstream leads, and project leadership.

* Ensure timely communication of key decisions, actions, risks, and governance updates.

* Support collaboration across business, functional, technical, testing, change management, and support teams.

* Support preparation of executive communications and steering committee materials.

* Build effective working relationships with client and internal stakeholders.

  
  

Continuous Improvement

  
  

* Contribute to PMO process improvements and standardization initiatives.

* Support project audits, compliance reviews, and lessons learned activities.

* Assist in development and enhancement of PMO templates, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.

* Support PMO maturity initiatives and knowledge management activities.

* Assist in onboarding and knowledge sharing for new PMO team members.

  
  

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

  
  

* 3-5 years of PMO, project controls, project coordination, governance, or transformation support experience.

* Experience supporting at least one end-to-end ERP implementation program.

* Experience supporting ERP implementation, application support, AMS, managed services, or operate engagements.

* Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP, SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise applications preferred.

* Experience working in Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery environments.

  
  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

  
  

* Project governance and reporting.

* RAID management and dependency tracking.

* Stakeholder coordination and communication.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Strong presentation and documentation capabilities.

* Understanding of project lifecycle and governance controls.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

  
  

**TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES**

* Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.

* Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent project management tools.

* Power BI reporting and dashboard exposure preferred.

  
  

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent certifications.

  
  

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Commerce, CA, or related discipline.

* MBA preferred.

  
  

**SUCCESS METRICS**

  
  

* Timely and accurate governance reporting.

* Effective action, risk, issue, dependency, and decision tracking.

* Compliance with PMO standards and reporting requirements.

* Effective monitoring of project milestones and delivery governance.

* High-quality stakeholder communication and coordination.

* Successful support of D365 implementation, rollout, enhancement, and go-live activities.

* Effective tracking and reporting of SLA performance, ticket management, backlog trends, and enhancement delivery metrics.

* Positive feedback from client stakeholders and project leadership on PMO effectiveness.

65634824.title: M365 End User Computing Architect
65634824.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.

The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end-to-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low-code/no-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance & Standards**
--------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC-impacting projects and provide design authority sign-off

**Security & Compliance**
-------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:

  + **Collaboration & Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
  + **Identity & Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
  + **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
  + **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
  + **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
  + **Automation & Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:

  + Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
  + Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI-readiness assessments

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.
  
  
A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
* You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
* You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
* You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically
* Ideally based in Mumbai, India.

In India, the OTE compensation range for this role is INR 7.4m - 9.8m OTE. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.
